title: Supply Planner
description:
Unbox Your Potential: Our customers see us as the industry Leader for trusted, high-quality food service essentials and supply chain solutions – and our employees see the value in what they do each day. We offer a culture supported by integrity, growth, relationships, and excellence. We’re looking for a Supply Planner – are you ready to explore your career with us?

The Supply Planner is responsible for all aspects of supply planning for assigned product categories. This role ensures alignment between forecasted demand and supply execution to support high customer service levels while maintaining inventory within targeted stocking parameters. The Supply Planner proactively reviews the assign product portfolio, plans requirements within lead time, and addresses potential risks and opportunities across the supply network.

This position is hybrid in our Exton, PA office - 3 days/week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday)

What you will do in this role:

  • Review assigned SKUs and plan purchase orders to meet forecasted demand across the ACR network and at the individual warehouse level.
  • Monitor supply plans to ensure requirements are planned within lead times and aligned with demand forecasts.
  • Identify potential shortages inside of lead time and partner with Sourcing and cross-functional teams to resolve gaps before customer impact.
  • Identify excess or slow-moving inventory and develop actions to mitigate future exposure.
  • Analyze inventory positions and recommend or execute inventory transfers to rebalance stock across network warehouses.
  • Maintain and manage planning system parameters, including minimum order quantities (MOQs), lead times, and service level targets, to support effective planning within the Supply Chain Planning system.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to planning accuracy, inventory optimization, and service performance.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of progressive experience in supply chain planning or related roles.
  • Working knowledge of importing goods from Asia.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable plans.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Solid understanding of supply planning principles and inventory management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Demonstrated sense of urgency and customer-focused mindset.

Pre-hire Process:

Employment offers are contingent upon a successful Criminal Background Check.

title: Senior Scheduling Engineer (Dallas)
description: Position Description: Lead development of construction project schedules with project stakeholders and team and monitor and track progress against defined schedule. Conduct scheduling analysis to assess risks and determine impact to schedule. Engage with project and local leadership and Scheduling team to provide support and monitor project progress. Essential Duties Key Responsibilities: Leverage understanding of work breakdown structure to capture entire construction project scope for developing schedules with more complex activities. Reference ‘Scheduling Playbook’ to adhere to Scheduling and company policies, practices, procedures, and activities. Maintain relationships with project stakeholders for communication of overall project plan and to support project performance and promote value of scheduling. Collaborate with project team to confirm Contract Item List (CIL), develop Required On Job (ROJ) dates for schedule, and review Procurement Schedule to track and assess subcontractor commitments. Develop project schedule based on Critical Path Method (CPM) logic-generated baseline schedules using scheduling software. Collaborate with project departments (e.g., Preconstruction, Commissioning, Procurement, Construction) to prepare detailed schedules. Collaborate with Virtual Design Construction (VDC) Engineer to align and coordinate schedules and models. Define project schedule metrics and monitor and track critical path activities to achieve predicted forecast end-date. Lead constructability reviews of project schedules and contribute to Project GMP submissions to ensure accuracy of scheduling details and timing. Maintain information required to update project schedule dashboard. Make project schedule updates based on project cadence and create target comparison, variances, and look-ahead schedules (e.g., make-ready plans, weekly work plans). Monitor and track progress at detailed and summary levels. Challenge project team based on previous, current, and future schedule data for As Built vs. Planned progress. Review Pull Plan and revise schedule accordingly and incorporate Last Planner System into schedule. Collaborate with project team to identify events and change order impacts to develop project schedule time impact analysis. Provide support and guidance to project end-users (individuals or groups) to develop proficiency in using scheduling software and promote training and evaluation for local projects. Keep current on and communicate new software enhancements with potential impact to scheduling operations. Prepare summary and detail level schedules aligned with objectives and requirements defined by project team. Participate in project kick-off meetings to ensure accuracy and completeness of scheduling documents. Engage with project team to review, develop, revise, and status schedules. Develop and update cost and/or resource loaded schedules. Review monthly scheduling progress and participate in project schedule reviews at Operations Review Meetings (ORMs) or other project review sessions. Conduct project site progress walks to capture scheduling progress data. Collaborate with and participate in Business Development (BD) and Marketing teams to develop and prepare pursuit schedules. Conduct project schedule reviews to verify progress shown on project schedule. Collaborate with project team to identify events and impacts to develop time impact analysis, claims, and fragnet. Apply continuous improvement methodology to daily tasks and activities and to improve Scheduling operations. Other activities, duties, and responsibilities as assigned. #LI-CH2

title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Platform Architect

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview
The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.

Role
• Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
• Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies.
• Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
• Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms.
• Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence.
• Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
• Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.

All About You
Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience
• Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments.
• Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures.
• Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure.
• Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.
• Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver highly available, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions while collaborating effectively across cross-functional engineering and business teams.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.

Desirable or Additional Capabilities
• Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
• Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
• Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Full Time Branch Ambassador - Livingston

Welcome to the future of banking. At Capital One, we believe your bank should be as mobile, intuitive, and human as the rest of your life. We are reimagining the way people interact with their money by creating community hubs where technology meets human empathy.

As a Branch Ambassador, you are the heartbeat of our space. You don't just "process transactions"—you embody our culture of outstanding hospitality. You are a relationship-builder who blends friendly, attentive service with cutting-edge digital innovation. Whether you’re helping a client navigate our latest tools or empowering them to reach their financial goals, you are the face of an exceptional, human-centric experience.

We are looking for curious, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-moving environment. You are someone who doesn't wait to be asked; you anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and have a genuine passion for helping people thrive in an evolving digital world.

What You’ll Actually Do

The Guardian of Trust & Accuracy You are the bedrock of our environment’s safety and integrity. You’ll execute high-volume cash transactions—including deposits, withdrawals, and complex negotiable instrument processing—with 100% accuracy. You maintain a "compliance-first" mindset, ensuring all security, audit, BSA/AML, and federal regulatory standards are met with precision to keep our customers' assets safe.

The Digital Concierge You are a mentor in a digital world. You’ll educate clients on how to leverage mobile banking, remote deposit capture, and contactless payments, helping them gain convenience and security in their daily financial lives.

The First-Line Consultant You aren’t just answering questions; you’re identifying needs. By actively listening, you’ll uncover personal or business goals and pair them with the right digital tools or banking solutions to help them succeed.

The Hospitality Lead You move fluidly throughout the space, greeting customers and ensuring no one ever feels like just a "number." You balance the efficiency of a high-volume operation with the warmth of a community-focused partner.

What You Bring

  • A Hospitality Heart: You have a natural gift for making people feel welcome and heard.
  • Tech Fluency: You are an early adopter of apps and digital tools and love teaching others how to use them.
  • Precision and Detail: You find satisfaction in getting the numbers right every single time and following clear procedures.
  • Adaptability: You enjoy a "fluid" workspace where you might move from a cash drawer to a digital demo in minutes.
  • Curiosity: You want to know the "why" behind the "how" and are always looking for ways to improve the customer journey.

Why Join Us?

This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Agile Coach
description:
*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*


Location: Santa Clara, CA OR Minneapolis, MN


Job Summary

As a Principal AI Driven SDLC Coach, you serve as the senior technical authority responsible for end-to-end coaching and governance of AI-driven full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). You design robust engineering guardrail harnesses and deliver structured hands-on coaching covering every SDLC phase. You standardize repeatable, secure, production-grade AI-augmented workflows for engineering teams, mitigate LLM hallucinations, technical debt, security vulnerabilities and inconsistent deliverables across the entire development lifecycle, while empowering engineers to maximize AI efficiency without compromising software quality, compliance and stability.


Key Responsibilities

Full AI-Driven SDLC Coaching & Hands-On Enablement

Lead formal training, 1:1 deep coaching, team workshops and live code clinics covering the complete AI-powered SDLC workflow:

  • Spec & Requirements Collection: Coach structured prompt design, user story refinement, ambiguous requirement decomposition, and AI-assisted formal specification drafting; guide teams to avoid vague inputs that cause flawed downstream deliverables.
  • Security Analysis & Threat Modeling: Train engineers to leverage AI tools for automated vulnerability scanning, attack surface mapping, OWASP compliance checks, data leakage risk assessment at the design phase (shift-left security via AI).
  • Implementation Planning: Guide AI-assisted architecture drafting, task breakdown, milestone scheduling, dependency mapping and modular development planning to prevent bloated or unmaintainable AI-generated solutions.
  • AI Code Generation: Establish disciplined vibe coding practices: structured prompt chaining, context injection, incremental code generation, and constrained model output to reduce redundant, buggy or non-idiomatic code.
  • Code Review Governance: Coach human-in-the-loop AI code auditing; build checklist-driven review frameworks to validate logic correctness, readability, performance and compliance of LLM-generated code.
  • Unit & Integration Testing: Train teams to use AI for test case auto-generation, edge case enumeration, mock data creation, automated test coverage validation and regression test suite construction.
  • Automated Documentation Generation: Standardize AI workflows for API docs, design docs, runbooks, comment blocks and release notes; ensure auto-generated documentation stays consistent with actual implemented code.
  • CI/CD Pipeline AI Integration: Coach embedding AI tools into build pipelines: pre-commit validation gates, in-flight code scanning, test auto-execution, artifact auditing and deployment approval automation within CI/CD workflows.


AI SDLC Harness Architecture & Tooling Build

  • Design, develop and maintain enterprise-grade technical harnesses that enforce guardrails across every SDLC stage listed above; embed automated validation gates to block unvetted AI outputs early in the lifecycle.
  • Integrate code LLMs, static/dynamic analysis tools, security scanners, test runners and doc generators into unified pipeline tooling natively hooked into existing CI/CD platforms.
  • Build observability dashboards to measure SDLC efficiency metrics: requirement clarity pass rate, security flaw escape rate, code rewrite overhead, test coverage ratio, documentation completeness and pipeline failure frequency caused by unregulated AI coding.
  • Continuously refine harness rules to counter LLM hallucinations, incomplete logic and insecure auto-generated artifacts across all development phases.


Enterprise Standardization & Compliance Governance

  • Author playbooks, prompt libraries, checklists and workflow templates for each AI SDLC stage for backend, frontend, cloud-native and embedded engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, legal, DevSecOps and compliance teams to bake license auditing, IP validation, sensitive data filtering and regulatory requirements into AI SDLC harness gates.
  • Enforce mandatory human review gates for high-risk modules (authentication, payment processing, PII handling) at every SDLC checkpoint regardless of AI automation maturity.


Required Qualifications

  • Software engineering experience with complete hands-on SDLC delivery
  • Proven expertise across requirements gathering, security design, implementation planning, formal code review, manual/automated testing, technical writing and end-to-end CI/CD pipeline design for production systems.
  • Deep practical AI coding & LLM workflow expertise
  • Hands-on experience leveraging code-generating LLMs across all SDLC phases; advanced prompt engineering, output constraint design, and mitigation of AI hallucinations and logical defects.
  • Experience building custom wrapper tooling/harnesses to govern and validate AI outputs in pipelines.


Core Competencies

  • Lifecycle-first mindset: prioritizing full SDLC robustness over isolated fast code generation
  • Structured coaching style adaptable for junior to staff-level engineers
  • Strategic risk balancing: accelerating delivery via AI while locking in security, maintainability and compliance
  • Strong cross-team communication and technical documentation capabilities

title: Facility Engineering Technician II
description:
LightEdge Solutions is developing the IT solutions that will propel businesses forward over the next 10 years. Using a combination of shared and private/dedicated platforms, LightEdge has been successful in offering businesses alternatives that streamline operations, improve reliability and reduce costs.
If you are passionate about creating real solutions that help businesses with cutting-edge technology, want to be challenged to think out of the box and be in a position where you can impact change on a daily basis, then LightEdge can offer you a dynamic corporate environment built on teamwork and personal responsibility.

The Facility Engineering Technician II is an experienced, hands-on critical-facilities individual contributor who operates, monitors, maintains, and troubleshoots assigned electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls, life-safety, and facility-support systems. This role works independently within approved procedures and provides reliable day-to-day support for 24x7 data-center infrastructure.

The Technician II performs routine and moderately complex work, responds to alarms and incidents, completes preventive and corrective maintenance, documents equipment conditions, and supports vendors, projects, commissioning, and operational turnover. The role escalates complex, high-risk, or unfamiliar conditions to a senior technician, engineer, or manager and may provide day-to-day guidance to Technician I employees.

Critical Facilities Systems Scope:

Electrical infrastructure: Utility service; medium- and low-voltage distribution; switchgear and switchboards; transformers; automatic transfer switches; standby generators and fuel systems; UPS systems, batteries, and energy-storage systems; PDUs; RPPs; panelboards; branch circuits; grounding and bonding; EPMS; and associated monitoring and control systems.

Mechanical and cooling infrastructure: Chillers; chilled-water systems; CRAH, CRAC, RTU, and air-handling units; pumps; motors; variable-frequency drives; cooling towers or dry coolers; water treatment; leak detection; environmental controls; and associated piping, valves, and controls.

Life safety and facility-support systems: Fire alarm and fire suppression systems; emergency lighting; building automation systems, including Tridium Niagara, WebCTRL, and Metasys where assigned; environmental monitoring; fuel monitoring; water detection; facility controls; and other systems required to maintain safe and reliable site operation.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Conduct scheduled facility rounds and record operating conditions, equipment status, alarms, readings, abnormalities, and required follow-up actions.
  • Monitor BMS, EPMS, DCIM, and other facility-monitoring platforms; investigate routine and moderately complex abnormal conditions and escalate issues in accordance with incident procedures.
  • Operate and maintain assigned electrical, mechanical, cooling, fire/life-safety, building-automation, and facility-support systems in accordance with approved procedures and qualifications.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance, inspections, equipment testing, minor repairs, and post-maintenance verification while protecting customer operations and system redundancy.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, emergency events, equipment failures, and loss-of-redundancy conditions; perform initial troubleshooting, stabilize conditions when authorized, and promptly escalate as required.
  • Execute approved MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, switching procedures, maintenance scripts, and other controlled operational documents; provide feedback for document updates.
  • Maintain working knowledge of assigned facility systems and serve as the day-to-day point of contact for equipment records, procedures, spare parts, maintenance history, and open issues.
  • Identify equipment deficiencies, capacity constraints, procedural gaps, and operational risks; communicate findings and recommended follow-up to the appropriate technical leader.
  • Coordinate routine vendor and contractor activities under the direction of a manager or senior technician, including site access, job-safety documentation, work execution, testing, punch-list items, and closeout documentation.
  • Manage assigned work requests and maintenance activities through the company CMMS or service-management platform, driving work to timely resolution.
  • Maintain accurate equipment records, asset data, configuration items in SNOW, maintenance history, operating logs, one-line diagrams, sequences of operation, as-built documentation, and site operating procedures.
  • Support facility capacity planning, energy-efficiency initiatives, infrastructure optimization, and readiness for customer deployments by collecting field data and reporting conditions.
  • Support construction, commissioning, integrated systems testing, equipment acceptance, punch-list completion, and operational turnover for new or modified facilities.
  • Assist with onboarding and practical training for Technician I employees on equipment operation, emergency procedures, safe work practices, and technical procedures.
  • Participate in shift coverage, nights, weekends, holidays, on-call rotations, emergency response, and travel to other LightEdge sites as assigned.

Safety, Compliance, and Work Control:

Perform all work in accordance with LightEdge safety policies, OSHA requirements, NFPA 70E practices, lockout/tagout procedures, PPE requirements, approved work permits, equipment-specific procedures, and applicable building, fire, environmental, and electrical codes.

  • Identify and report unsafe conditions, procedural gaps, equipment hazards, and compliance risks.
  • Follow approved work-control, change-management, risk-assessment, and peer-review processes before performing work that could affect critical operations.
  • Support audits, inspections, emergency exercises, safety training, and corrective actions.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Three or more years of experience in data-center operations, critical facilities, industrial facilities, commercial building operations, hospitals, utilities, military facilities, skilled trades, or another mission-critical environment; equivalent technical education or military training may be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience operating, inspecting, maintaining, or troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, HVAC, controls, or life-safety systems.
  • Ability to work independently on routine and moderately complex tasks while recognizing when to seek assistance or escalate risk.
  • Ability to read and apply electrical one-lines, mechanical drawings, control diagrams, equipment manuals, and sequences of operation with appropriate guidance.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts, weekends, holidays, on-call rotations, and emergency events as required by site operations.
  • Ability to use CMMS, BMS, EPMS, DCIM, or similar operational systems and maintain accurate technical records.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree, technical degree, military training, trade-school certification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced experience with UPS systems, generators, switchgear, ATS equipment, PDUs, RPPs, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, pumps, motors, and building controls.
  • Experience with Niagara, or similar BMS platforms and with EPMS or power-monitoring systems.
  • NFPA 70E, OSHA, EPA 608, OEM, electrical, HVAC, controls, or stationary-engine certifications, as applicable to the assigned site.
  • Experience supporting commissioning, integrated systems testing, design reviews, construction turnover, or high-density data-center deployments.

Physical and Work Environments Requirements:

  • Ability to work in a 24x7 data-center environment that may include rotating shifts, extended hours, nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call assignments.
  • Ability to walk, stand, climb stairs and ladders, reach, bend, kneel, crouch, work above shoulder level, and work in mechanical and electrical rooms.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull equipment and materials within the limits established by the company’s approved job analysis and applicable accommodations process.
  • Ability to work safely in areas with elevated noise, temperature variation, construction activity, PPE requirements, and energized or potentially energized equipment under approved safe-work practices.
  • Ability to travel between LightEdge facilities as required for training, project support, incident response, or operational coverage.

Success Measures:

• Safe and reliable operation of assigned critical-facilities systems.
• Timely and accurate completion of preventive maintenance, work requests, operating logs, and technical documentation.
• Effective first-response troubleshooting, escalation, and follow-through for incidents and equipment abnormalities.
• High-quality execution and closeout of MOPs, EOPs, SOPs, vendor work, projects, and commissioning activities.
• Demonstrated progress toward broader system qualifications and productive support of Technician I development.

General Position Statement:

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications, or working conditions. Responsibilities may be adjusted based on business needs, site requirements, and applicable laws.

With over 20 years in business, LightEdge offers a full stack of best-in-class IT services delivering flexibility, security, and control. Our solutions include premier colocation across seven purpose-built data centers spanning Des Moines, IA, Kansas City, MO, Omaha, NE, Austin, TX, and Raleigh, NC, industry-leading private Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and cloud platforms, and the top global security and compliance measures. Our owned and operated facilities, integrated DR solutions, and premium compliant cloud choices make up a true Hybrid Cloud Solution Center. LightEdge annually undergoes third-party audits for ISO 20000-1, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS 3.2, and SSAE 18 SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3.

title: Salesforce Architect (Salesforce CPQ)
description:
Who We Are:
At Emburse, you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise.

We are looking for a Salesforce Architect (Salesforce CPQ) to serve as the master technical builder of our enterprise revenue engine. In a high-growth, private-equity-backed SaaS environment, simply "configuring" Salesforce isn't enough—we are actively transforming how our business scales. Reporting directly to the Director of Business Systems, you will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Salesforce CRM and CPQ while partnering closely with our teams responsible for Billing, ERP, and marketing applications.

We are looking for an architect who built their career on deep developer roots. You aren't an "ivory tower" consultant; you are a pragmatic technical leader who can design complex Quote-to-Cash data flows, dive deep and guide dev teams on code standards, and challenge business stakeholders to simplify processes rather than digitizing messiness.

What You Will Do

  • Architect the Revenue Engine: Lead the technical design and redesign of our Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) and Lead-to-Cash (L2C) architecture, focusing on Salesforce CPQ and CRM along with the integrated Q2C ecosystem.

  • Drive Business Transformation: Work directly with business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable enterprise architecture—challenging existing processes to drive simplification and automation in our Sales motions.

  • Define System Boundaries: Architect clean, robust integrations between Salesforce, CPQ and integrated enterprise systems (BillingPlatform(™), NetSuite, Marketo, HubSpot, and more ).

  • Provide Technical Leadership: Guide and mentor technical teams and developers by leveraging your significant developer background to perform code reviews, enforce Apex/LWC standards, and drive robust solutioning discussions.

  • Triage & Optimize: Evaluate trade-offs between out-of-the-box functionality vs. custom development, eliminating technical debt while prioritizing business velocity.

What You Will Bring

  • Hands-on Developer Roots: Proven background as a Salesforce CPQ Developer who has successfully transitioned into a Technical/Solution Architect role.

  • Transformation Track Record: Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end Digital or Business Transformation projects specifically focused on Quote-to-Cash or Lead-to-Cash redesign and optimization.

  • Cross-Platform Integration Mastery: Broad familiarity and integration design experience with enterprise systems like NetSuite, Marketo, HubSpot, BillingPlatform(™), Gong, and Snowflake.

  • Process Simplification Mindset: A strong track record of rethinking and optimizing business processes rather than simply recreating legacy workflows in Salesforce.

  • Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional ability to communicate technical tradeoffs, system limits, and architectural decisions to non-technical business leaders.

Who You Are

  • A Pragmatic Architect: You know how code should be written because you’ve written it. You use that best-practice knowledge to guide dev teams and build architectures that work fluidly in production.

  • A Problem Solver: You love a challenge and figuring out how to solve them because optimizing Salesforce ecosystems has been the driving factor in your successful career.

  • A Business Partner: You aren't a master of your domain. When a stakeholder asks for a shortcut that adds technical debt, you offer a better, more scalable alternative.

  • An Efficiency Champion: You live to eliminate friction in sales cycles, streamline quote line calculations, and ensure data flows cleanly from lead generation to revenue recognition.

Why Emburse?
Finance is changing—and at Emburse, we’re leading the way. Our AI-powered solutions help organizations eliminate inefficiencies, gain real-time visibility, and optimize spend—so they can focus on what’s next, not what’s slowing them down.
• A Company with Momentum – We serve 12M+ users across 120 countries, helping businesses modernize
their finance operations.
• A Team That Innovates – Work alongside some of the brightest minds in finance, tech, and AI to solve real-
world challenges.
• A Culture That Empowers – Competitive pay, flexible work, and an inclusive, collaborative environment that
supports your success.
• A Career That Matters – Your work here drives efficiency, innovation, and smarter financial decision-making
for businesses everywhere.
Shape your future & find what’s next at Emburse.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Software Engineer

Position Overview
The Business Experimentation and Optimization (BE&O) teams within Mastercard’s Services organization are building industry-leading software that empowers business users around the world to make data-driven decisions through advanced analytics and experimentation. As we expand our product offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions to our clients.

We are seeking a technically strong Senior Software Engineer to help drive the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation experimentation platform. In this role, you will help define and evolve system architecture and non-functional requirements, including scalability, performance, security, and reliability, ensuring our solutions meet the highest engineering standards. As a Senior SE, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to drive complex technical solutions, lead team-level design, and deliver scalable services, APIs, and analytics-driven capabilities using technologies such as Java, Databricks, cloud platforms, and modern data technologies.

Our teams are small, agile, and empowered to choose the processes that work best for their goals. Every engineer contributes to the full development lifecycle, from ideation and design through implementation and testing, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.

What is the Services organization?

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, delivering cutting-edge solutions that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling rapidly across the globe, this team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse, global customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with rich data assets and in-house technology to provide clients with powerful insights and tools that drive fact-based decision-making. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, our services include consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation, and data-informed information and risk management. While specializing in the payments industry, Mastercard Services also partners closely with major retailers, airlines, and other enterprises, leveraging insights drawn from both within and beyond our network.

We are seeking passionate and talented technologists who share our vision of empowering customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions. Join us and help shape the future growth of our team.

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you.

Position Responsibilities:

As a part of Mastercard Services, you will build innovative products that help businesses around the world unlock more value from their data. As a Senior Software Engineer within BE&O, you will contribute to full-stack, data-intensive, analytics-driven applications that support sophisticated business experimentation and decision-making for some of the world’s largest organizations. You will:

Lead team level system design, including high level design, detailed design, API contracts, data flows, service interactions, integration patterns, and nonfunctional requirements such as scalability, reliability, performance, security, and operability.
Partner with lead engineers and architects to align team level implementations with broader platform architecture, modernization goals, engineering standards, and long term maintainability.
Develop and optimize data intensive applications and analytics capabilities using Databricks, Spark, and related technologies to process and deliver data at scale.
Serve as a hands on technical contributor, designing, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering production quality software across the full engineering lifecycle.
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across services, APIs, data processing workloads, and user experiences.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Mentor junior and midlevel engineers through technical guidance, pairing, code reviews, design feedback, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture by modeling ownership, clear communication, continuous learning, pragmatic decision making, and high standards for software quality.
Improve engineering quality through code reviews, design reviews, automated testing, secure coding practices, observability, performance tuning, CI/CD practices, and production readiness.
Troubleshoot complex issues across application, service, API, data, and cloud layers, driving root cause analysis and implementing durable solutions that improve platform reliability and supportability.

Ideal qualifications include:

title: Front End Engineer - React
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of data?

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.


At Matillion, we are moving beyond traditional data processing to define the future of the AI Data Automation Platform. Our mission is to make data "AI-ready" at the speed of thought, centred around Maia - our autonomous AI data engineering foundation.

As a Frontend Engineer, you will build the interfaces that make that mission real, using React and an agentic-first mindset - working alongside AI tools like Claude not as a shortcut, but as an essential partner in how you engineer. You will own high-visibility features, act as a skilled validator of AI-generated code, and help set the bar for what "production-ready" means on our team.

This is a hybrid role based in Manchester, UK, with minimum 2 days a week in the office.

What you will be doing

  • Build production React and TypeScript components for Maia and Maia Teams - clean, readable, built for your teammates to extend.
  • Run an agentic-first workflow: use GenAI tools daily to handle the repetitive work, so your time goes on architecture and hard logic.
  • Act as the human-in-the-loop - review, refactor and harden AI-suggested code against our security and performance bar.
  • Break epics into shippable increments and keep a steady flow of value through CI/CD.
  • Shape front-end architecture with your squad - component patterns, state management, the calls that outlast a single sprint.

What we are looking for

  • Professional experience shipping production React applications, with testable, well-documented code.
  • Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools, paired with the judgement to critically validate every output rather than trust it blind.
  • A structured, systematic approach to diagnosing and fixing issues in a frontend service.
  • Strong grasp of modern web security and self-documenting code practices.
  • Comfort across the full SDLC - Agile, CI/CD, version control - in a live production environment.

At Matillion, we are committed to providing competitive salaries in line with market standards. Our estimated compensation range for this position is £47,200 to £70,800, but the final salary will be based on your relevant skills, experience and qualifications demonstrated in the hiring process.


More about Matillion

title: Director, Product Management
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Director, Product Management

Overview:

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Within Mastercard Services, the Global Portfolio Optimization (GPO) team helps issuers maximize portfolio performance through data-driven strategies that improve customer activation, usage, engagement, and top-of-wallet positioning.

The Director, Product Management, Global Portfolio Optimization (Target) will play a critical leadership role in defining and scaling the capabilities that enable GPO to accelerate the journey from insight to action. This role sits within the Target pillar of the Portfolio Optimization framework and is responsible for driving the continued productization of GPO's end-to-end operating model (Target > Create > Execute > Measure) through close partnership with Business & Market Intelligence (B&MI), product teams, technology partners, and stakeholders across Mastercard.

The role will lead the evolution of how portfolio optimization insights are transformed into scalable products, recommendations, and actions through Mastercard's Intelligence Centre (MIC) platform. In addition, this leader will define and drive GPO's AI strategy, identifying opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, automation, and advanced analytics to increase team effectiveness, accelerate decision-making, and enhance issuer outcomes.

This is a highly cross-functional product leadership role that combines strategic thinking, technical fluency, quantitative rigor, and strong stakeholder management to deliver solutions that drive measurable business impact at scale.

Have you successfully built and scaled products that transform complex business processes into repeatable, technology-enabled solutions?

Are you comfortable operating at the intersection of business strategy, analytics, AI, and technology delivery?

Do you enjoy translating insights into products that drive measurable outcomes for customers and internal stakeholders?

Are you passionate about leveraging AI, automation, and product thinking to unlock new levels of organizational impact?

Role:

Lead the continued productization of the Global Portfolio Optimization operational framework (Target > Create > Execute > Measure) in partnership with the Business & Market Intelligence (B&MI) team, creating scalable products and capabilities that accelerate the insights-to-action lifecycle.

Own and evolve the product strategy, roadmap, and requirements for capabilities that enable portfolio optimization teams to identify opportunities, generate recommendations, execute strategies, and measure business outcomes at scale.

Serve as the primary business lead and relationship manager for the Mastercard Intelligence Centre (MIC), ensuring GPO insights, recommendations, and actions are effectively productized and operationalized through the platform.

Define and drive GPO's AI strategy by partnering with the AI Centre of Excellence, Foundry, AI Governance teams, engineering organizations, and external technology providers to identify, prioritize, and execute proof-of-concepts and pilots that demonstrate business value and scalability.

Evaluate emerging AI, automation, and analytics capabilities to determine their feasibility, desirability, and viability within GPO workflows and operating models.

Collaborate closely with stakeholders across the GPO verticals (Target, Create, Execute, and Measure) to understand end-to-end workflows, identify pain points and opportunities, define product requirements, and deliver solutions that improve efficiency, automation, scalability, and business impact.

Develop deep understanding of Mastercard products, platforms, and capabilities that can enhance issuer portfolio performance across current and future GPO priorities, including Activation, Usage, and Top-of-Wallet initiatives.

Build and maintain strong partnerships with product owners, platform leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders across Mastercard to identify opportunities for integration, capability reuse, and accelerated delivery of value to issuers.

Translate complex business challenges into clear product requirements, business cases, prioritization frameworks, and measurable success metrics.

Establish KPI frameworks and measurement approaches to evaluate the effectiveness, adoption, and impact of newly deployed products and capabilities.

Lead cross-functional teams through the product lifecycle from opportunity identification and concept development through implementation, adoption, and optimization.

Track and manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment while driving execution against key strategic priorities.

All About You:

Significant product management experience with a proven track record of defining, building, launching, and scaling technology-enabled products, platforms, or capabilities.

Strong product management fundamentals, including customer discovery, requirements definition, roadmap development, prioritization, product delivery, and performance measurement.

Technical fluency and comfort working closely with engineering, data science, analytics, AI, and platform teams. Ability to understand technical architectures and translate business needs into actionable product requirements.

Highly quantitative and analytically minded, with demonstrated ability to leverage data, experimentation, and insights to drive decision-making and business outcomes.

Strong understanding of AI technologies, generative AI (including Large Tabular Models), machine learning applications, and automation opportunities, with the ability to evaluate potential use cases and translate them into practical business solutions.

Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving analytics, data products, workflow transformation, operational optimization, or AI-enabled solutions.

Personal and professional proficiency using AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, communication, analysis, and execution effectiveness.

Ability to navigate ambiguity, synthesize complex information, and create clear strategies and execution plans.

Experience developing business cases, prioritization frameworks, and success metrics for new capabilities and investments.

Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align diverse groups around a common vision and roadmap.

Ability to identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, capability reuse, and scalable growth across products, platforms, and business processes.

Strong strategic thinking skills combined with a hands-on execution mindset.

Experience working in matrixed organizations and driving outcomes through influence rather than direct authority.

Team player able to work effectively across functions, levels, and geographies while fostering collaboration and driving consensus.

Passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and leveraging technology to create measurable customer and business impact.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Art Director (Casual Temporary)
location: Kissimmee, Florida, United States of America
description:
About the Role & Team:

Through innovative storytelling and a culture of collaboration, Disney Live Entertainment creates, produces, and delivers remarkable and engaging entertainment experiences! From the intimate to the spectacular, our work can be seen at Disney theme parks, resort hotels, cruise ships, and other locations the world over. This team with varied strengths – representing a wide variety of subject areas and talents from technical directors, writers, and lighting designers to choreographers, cosmetologists, and music producers – brings magical worlds to life through technical expertise, performance excellence, outstanding resourcefulness, unparalleled spectacle… and a dash of pixie dust!

The Art Director creates, develops, and executes innovative, unique production and scenic designs in support of original and adapted live entertainment experiences, including large stage shows, spectaculars, and parades. Through collaboration with our Director of Creative Development, Show Directors, Lighting Designers, Audio Designers, Special Effects Designers, Technical Directors, Producers, Production Managers, Walt Disney Imagineering, and Marketing partners, The Art Director will develop themed environments which convey the emotions and visual story of our live experiences!

You will report to the Manager, Art Studio

  • Participate and influence the project's creative development
  • Develop and implement scenic art designs and facility infrastructure as assigned
  • Work with external vendors and contractors to guide the creative work and provide leadership to crews installing artwork on projects
  • Research and produce concept art for design development and presentations
  • Collaborate with key production teams to ensure that the scenic design elements are seamlessly and safely integrated into the overall project
  • Produce design intent drawings, 5-view detailed drawings, provide materials selection, color callouts, and color elevations to help select vendors and communicate project information
  • Provide art direction in the field and to vendors to ensure that the final product meets the design vision
  • Partner with the Principal Art Director to provide input to art & design budget and labor requirements
  • Stay current with art research and development efforts within the industry including scenic, visual, and graphic trends
  • Partner with consultant scenic designers and vendors to ensure Disney quality, compatibility, training, and accurate documentation of all scenic elements is delivered
  • Conduct ongoing "entertainment show quality" evaluations of existing offerings and provide support to maintain original show intent
  • Establish, build, and maintain open relationships based on trust and partnering with key clients and supporting departments

  • 5+ years of experience in an entertainment design field
  • Outstanding knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
  • Proven hand-drawing, sketching, and illustration abilities
  • Strong drafting knowledge and ability to read technical drawings
  • Desired proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, CAD Tools, or Vectorworks
  • Ability to handle multiple projects; strong background in logistics
  • Excellent communication skills and follow through
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Demonstrated leadership ability to give direction and lead a crew, while maintaining a safe and productive workplace
  • Strong budgeting skills
  • Ability to be flexible with work schedule, including weekends and holidays

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Theatrical Design

Preferred Education

title: Product Engineer (Electrical)
description:
Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Location: Raleigh, NC


About the Role

The Customer Order Engineer (Electrical Product Engineer) plays a vital role in the design and development of custom electrical products tailored to the customers' specific needs. This role will work closely with the sales, engineering, and production teams to create detailed electrical designs, generate accurate quotes and Bills of Materials (BOMs), and provide technical support throughout the project lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Electrical Design:
  • Work closely with the sales team and customers to understand their unique requirements and specifications.
  • Develop detailed electrical designs, including schematics, layouts, and component selection, to meet project objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards, codes, and safety regulations.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to integrate electrical designs seamlessly into overall product designs.
  • Quotation and Costing:
  • Create accurate and competitive quotes for custom-engineered electrical products, taking into account material costs, labor, overhead, and other relevant expenses.
  • Collaborate with procurement and suppliers to obtain pricing for electrical components.
  • Review and refine quotes to optimize cost-effectiveness while meeting customer expectations.
  • Calculate labor and manufacturing costs.
  • Consider project timelines and potential risks when creating quotes.
  • Bills of Materials (BOMs):
  • Generate detailed and costed Bills of Materials (BOMs) for electrical products, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain BOMs in the company's ERP system, including part creation, updates, and revisions.
  • Work closely with the production team to resolve any BOM-related issues and discrepancies.
  • Technical Support:
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for customers, addressing inquiries and providing technical expertise throughout project development.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve electrical design issues during production.
  • Documentation and Record Keeping:
  • Maintain thorough documentation of electrical designs, quotes, BOMs, and related project data.
  • Ensure that all documentation is organized, accessible, and up to date.
  • Quality Assurance:
  • Conduct quality checks on electrical designs to ensure accuracy and reliability.
  • Participate in design reviews to identify and address potential issues early in the process.
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in electrical engineering.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy in electrical design and quoting.


Required Qualifications

Education and specialized knowledge, skill, or experience (e.g., technical, scientific, administrative, managerial), which this position requires.

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience in electrical design for custom-engineered products.
  • Proficiency in CAD software for electrical design (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks Electrical).
  • Familiarity with ERP systems for part creation and BOM management.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical components, circuits, and systems.
  • Excellent communication and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge and experience with electrical power distribution products and systems (switchgear, electric distribution panels, circuit breakers)
  • Proven experience in quoting for custom-engineered products.
  • Advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Familiarity with relevant industry standards and regulations.

Physical/Environmental Demands

  • Ability to work in an office and manufacturing environment, including occasional visits to the production floor for product testing and validation.

Physical/Environmental Demands

  • Up to 10%. Occasional travel may be needed (customer visits, industry conferences, trade shows, training, etc.).

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
Staff AI Engineer

Job Description

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.

  • Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch, and more.

  • Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.

  • Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good.

  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production.

  • You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven.

  • You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss.

  • You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies

  • At least 8 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)

  • Experience architecting, designing, developing, integrating, delivering, and supporting complex AI systems

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor multiple engineering teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders up to the VP level

  • Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, or Golang

  • Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost

  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers

title: Fiber Optic Specialist - Weekend - Second Shift (Fri, Sat, Sun)
description:
About Commonwealth Fusion Systems:
Commonwealth Fusion Systems is on a mission to deliver the urgent transition to fusion energy.
Combining decades of research, top talent, and new technologies, we’re designing and building commercially viable fusion power plants. And we're working with policymakers, suppliers, and many others to build the energy industry of the future.
We’re in the best position to make it happen. Since 2018, we’ve raised $4 billion of capital, making us the largest and leading fusion company in the world.
Now we’re looking for more thinkers, doers, builders, and makers to join us. People who’ll bring new perspectives, solve tough problems, and thrive as part of a team.
If that’s you and this role fits, we want to hear from you.

Join the power movement as a Fiber Optic Specialist
The Fiber Optic Applications Technician is an exciting and evolving role with a responsibility for assisting R&D and production staff with all aspects of optical fiber work such as fiber splicing, testing, and incorporation of fibers into complex design features while minimizing damage and attenuation to the fiber throughout its lifetime. The technician will ensure functional operation and preventative maintenance of equipment as well as continuous improvement. Responsibilities include close cooperation with Operations, Maintenance, Quality and other departments to ensure goals and objectives are met. This role will lead the way to making Earth sustainable for the future to come.
This work is conducted within a multi-disciplinary team of technicians and engineers. Participation and clear, concise communication while working with the team is crucial.
Hours: 6:00 pm - 6:00 am
Work Friday, Saturday, Sunday nights
Rate of pay: $38 - $48 per hour + 30% differential

What you'll do:

  • Conduct the handling, routing, splicing, testing, and potential repair of 1000’s of fibers throughout the SPARC fusion machine
  • Perform mechanical integration of small assemblies adjacent or in conjunction with the fiber work, such as passthrough flanges and enclosures for the fibers
  • Install composite or polymer wrappings for the fibers and their enclosures
  • Train other technicians as needed in the proper installation, splicing, routing, and measurement procedures
  • Improve safety protocols for laser and fiber optic handling
  • Fulfill manufacturing and R&D fiber needs

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years experience in fiber optics field applications
  • Experience with taking attenuation, insertion loss, and spectral analysis measurements using various measurement equipment (such as OTDR, OSA, OBR, power meter, etc.)
  • Must have experience fiber handling in a lab setting with known standards

Bonus points for:

  • 7+ years experience in fiber optics field applications
  • Experience in utilizing distributed sensing arrays
  • Experience with polyimide and a variety of coated fibers
  • At least 1 year experience in teaching and/or training fiber splicing techniques and cable assemblies
  • Experienced with designing, building, and testing fiber cable assemblies, particularly in cryogen and vacuum conditions
  • Experience performing fiber optic work in environments with limited space or requiring odd positions.
  • Skills:
  • Fiber coating removal
  • Fiber re-coating
  • Specialty fiber splicing
  • Fiber proof-testing
  • Measurement and analysis techniques with optical tools and equipment such as interrogators, optical multiplexers, optical switches, fault locators, OTDR, etc.
  • Knowledgeable about various optics sensing techniques and optical attenuation/insertion loss mechanisms
  • Basic Materials Science knowledge
  • Good communication skills
  • Good attention to detail

Must-have Requirements:

  • Ability to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs
  • Perform activities:
  • Stooping, typing, standing, or sitting for extended periods of time
  • May need to operate in small confined places in odd locations
  • Work locations could include being on platforms around 25 feet high
  • Dedication to safety to mitigate industrial hazards that may include heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, lead (Pb), high voltage, and cryogenics
  • Willingness to travel or work required nights/weekends/on-call occasionally
#LI-Onsite

At CFS, we excel in fast-paced environments, driven by our values of integrity, execution, impact, and self-critique. As we grow, we’re eager to bring on mission-driven folks who offer diverse perspectives and fresh ways to tackle challenges.
