  • 3-5 years’ experience in healthcare program implementation, clinical operations, patient navigation, care coordination/ case management, quality improvement, patient and family safety, provider engagement or a related field.

We would love if you also have and are able to

So what's in it for you?

Komen believes in the importance of taking care of our employees so that in turn they can be committed to supporting our critical mission to support those impacted by breast cancer and to help find cures. This is what Komen provides away from the computer:

  • Competitive salary of $56,000 to $71,000/ annually, exact compensation ranges are based on a range of factors including but not limited to the labor market, job level, internal equity, and budget. Offers given will take into consideration the candidate's skills, education, experience, geographic location, and other necessary credentials.

Komen provides a remote and/or home-based working environment for all active employees. Work schedules for both remote and home based are determined by the organizational needs of each department.

title: Area Scout - Venezuela (West)
description:
DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW / DESCRIPCIÓN DEL DEPARTAMENTO

The Boston Red Sox International Scouting Department is committed to identifying and acquiring impact amateur and professional talent globally and integrating them into our player development system. We empower our staff to grow as individuals while we strive as a team to be at the forefront of the industry’s best practices in relation to player evaluation, analytical methods and staff development.

El Departamento de Escouteo Internacional de los Boston Red Sox está comprometido con identificar y adquirir talento amateur y profesional de impacto a nivel mundial, integrándolo a nuestro sistema de desarrollo de jugadores. Brindamos a nuestro personal las herramientas para crecer como individuos, mientras trabajamos en equipo para mantenernos a la vanguardia de las mejores prácticas de la industria en cuanto a evaluación de jugadores, métodos de análisis y desarrollo del personal.

POSITION OVERVIEW / DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PUESTO:

The Boston Red Sox are seeking an Area Scout to cover territory in the Zulia region of Venezuela. In this role, the Area Scout will cover and report on players in Venezuela, collaborate with other scouting staff and leadership, and make recommendations on signing players. The Area Scout will also help with additional assignments/coverages as assigned by immediate supervisors.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Zulia region to be considered.

Mechanical Product Design Engineer

About the Role

We are seeking a highly creative, design-focused Mechanical Engineer to support the development of next-generation consumer hardware products. The ideal candidate is an Industrial Design-savvy Mechanical Engineer who thrives in the early stages of product development and has extensive experience partnering directly with Industrial Designers to transform design intent into functional, manufacturable products.

This role will sit at the intersection of Industrial Design and Mechanical Engineering, helping translate early concepts and user experiences into viable mechanical architectures, prototypes, mechanisms, and ultimately production-ready solutions.

The ideal candidate will bring strong mechanical engineering fundamentals while also possessing an excellent understanding of product aesthetics, form, ergonomics, materials, and the Industrial Design process.

Responsibilities

• Partner closely with Industrial Designers to translate design intent and early product concepts into technically feasible mechanical solutions.

• Drive front-end product development, including concept exploration, mechanical architecture, feasibility assessment, rapid prototyping, and iterative design.

• Develop creative mechanical solutions that preserve the intended product experience, aesthetics, form factor, and functionality.

• Create and refine detailed 3D CAD models and assemblies using Siemens NX.

• Build and evaluate high-fidelity prototypes, mockups, mechanisms, and proof-of-concept hardware to quickly assess design directions.

• Evaluate materials, manufacturing processes, component packaging, assembly methods, and mechanical architecture during early product development.

• Collaborate across Industrial Design, Product Design Engineering, Electrical Engineering, manufacturing, and other technical teams to move concepts toward production.

• Identify technical risks and design constraints early while developing solutions that minimize compromise to the original design intent.

• Apply DFM/DFA, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and sound mechanical engineering principles as concepts mature toward production.

• Work with internal teams and external manufacturing partners to develop and validate novel components, processes, and product solutions.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

• 5+ years of mechanical/product design engineering experience, ideally developing consumer electronics, wearable technology, or other highly designed physical products.

• Advanced hands-on experience with Siemens NX for 3D CAD modeling, assemblies, and mechanical design.

• Demonstrated experience working directly and collaboratively with Industrial Design teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

• Strong front-end development experience, including concept development, feasibility, prototyping, mechanical architecture, and design iteration.

• Proven ability to translate Industrial Design intent into functional and manufacturable mechanical solutions.

• Experience designing plastic and/or metal components for production manufacturing processes.

• Strong hands-on prototyping and mechanical problem-solving skills.

• Experience collaborating across ID, ME/PDE, EE, manufacturing, and other cross-functional engineering disciplines.

• Strong communication and visualization skills with the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing high-volume consumer electronics, handheld devices, wearable products, AR/VR hardware, or similarly complex consumer products.

• Experience owning mechanical designs from early concept exploration through manufacturing and production.

• Strong understanding of Industrial Design principles, including aesthetics, ergonomics, form development, materials, finishes, and user experience.

• Experience developing highly cosmetic products where mechanical solutions must preserve strict Industrial Design requirements.

• Experience with complex surfacing and advanced CAD modeling in Siemens NX.

• Knowledge of DFM/DFA, GD&T, statistical tolerance analysis, functional dimensioning, and manufacturing processes.

• Experience defining product-level mechanical architectures and integrating complex internal components within constrained product envelopes.

• Experience working directly with prototype shops, suppliers, and manufacturing partners to rapidly develop and evaluate new concepts.

title: Senior eClinical Business Lead, IRT & DHT Design Consultant
description:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior eClinical Business Lead (IRT and DHT Design Consultant). As a Senior eClinical Business Lead, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in RTSM and DHT study design, requirements analysis, stakeholder collaboration, and clinical trial optimization. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout. Responsibilities include providing expert consultation on digital health technology implementation, translating complex requirements into actionable solutions, and ensuring seamless integration across clinical trial systems.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing clinical trial technology, improving study efficiency, and enhancing patient engagement. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior eClinical Business Lead can explore career paths and expand expertise across clinical research and digital health innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide expert consultation to project leaders and study teams on RTSM and DHT study design, requirements gathering, and system configuration

  • Analyze protocols and collaborate with stakeholders to develop, review, and validate user requirements that align with study design objectives and regulatory standards

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to RTSM and DHT implementation, ensuring compliance with clinical trial processes and data integrity standards

  • Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable guidance for study teams and system users to facilitate informed decision-making

  • Evaluate system integrations and proactively identify potential issues with third-party interfaces, data flows, and user requirements to ensure seamless functionality

  • Partner with UAT leads to design, execute, and validate testing protocols, ensuring systems meet defined requirements and business objectives

  • Stay current on emerging RTSM and DHT technologies, industry best practices, and regulatory developments to drive continuous improvement and innovation

  • Manage quality assurance and timely delivery of project deliverables while implementing corrective actions to maintain excellence

  • Interact with external clients to discuss RTSM and DHT design considerations, protocol requirements, and implementation strategies

  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and deliver timely, effective solutions to client challenges and technical issues

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Deep expertise in RTSM and DHT systems, clinical trial design, and requirements management

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to work independently and escalate appropriately

  • Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment

  • Exceptional ability to collaborate across teams and communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences

  • Patient-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity

  • Comfort working with RTSM platforms, digital health technology (DHT) solutions, and clinical trial management systems (CTMS)

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • 5+ years of experience in building RTSM and/or DHT clinical trial systems, developing user requirements, and managing requirements gathering, configuration, design, and user acceptance testing

  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes

  • Excellent technical and data standards knowledge with proven experience applying data standards in clinical trial environments

  • Demonstrated ability to create and explain business processes and train others on implementation

  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of industry standards such as CDISC SDTM and other data standards relevant to clinical trials

  • Experience with eCOA or ePRO systems and digital health technology platforms

  • Proven track record of conducting root cause analysis and driving process improvement initiatives

  • Demonstrated client-focused approach with ability to build and maintain strong client relationships


We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

title: Sanitation Supervisor
description:
SANITATION SUPERVISOR

Join Team Bento and be a part of our group of companies which operates more than 12000 locations globally. With operations across Canada and United States, Bento brings together a dynamic team of people with diverse backgrounds, experience, and talent, to create an exceptional guest experience.


Location

  • Texas Food Factory: 520 Shepherd Drive Unit 14 Garland, TX 75042 | Monday to Saturday starting at 5:00 am


Responsibilities

The Sanitation Supervisor leads overnight sanitation operations in the Ready-to-Eat (RTE) food manufacturing facility, ensuring equipment and production areas meet company, food safety, and regulatory standards. This role verifies cleaning effectiveness, prevents contamination and cross-contamination, and ensures production areas are ready for startup.

  • Supervise and coordinate daily sanitation operations for RTE processing and packaging areas.
  • Ensure compliance with food safety programs including HACCP, GMPs, SSOPs, allergen control, and environmental monitoring programs.
  • Verify proper cleaning and sanitizing of equipment, utensils, conveyors, drains, walls, floors, and production lines.
  • Conduct pre-operational inspections to ensure equipment and production areas are ready for startup.
  • Monitor chemical usage, concentrations, and safe handling procedures.
  • Train sanitation employees on cleaning procedures, PPE requirements, chemical safety, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), GMPs, and hygiene practices.
  • Maintain sanitation records, logs, and documentation accurately and completely.
  • Coordinate with QA, Maintenance, and Production departments to ensure sanitation effectiveness and production schedules are met.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA safety regulations and company safety policies.
  • Investigate sanitation deficiencies and implement corrective actions.
  • Monitor sanitation KPIs including ATP results, environmental swabs, audit findings, and downtime.
  • Assist during third-party, customer, USDA/FDA, and internal audits.
  • Ensure proper storage and labeling of sanitation chemicals and tools.
  • Enforce employee attendance, discipline, and performance expectations.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to sanitation efficiency and food safety.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; associate degree or food science background preferred.
  • Minimum 2-5 years of sanitation supervisory experience in a food manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in RTE or high-risk food manufacturing strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of HACCP principles, SQF, BRC or other GFSI standards, GMPs, SSOPs, allergen control, environmental monitoring, and chemical safety.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 50 pounds while working for extended periods in wet, cold, and noisy production environments.
  • Ability to read and understand sanitation procedures and SDS documentation.
  • HACCP certification, SQF Practitioner training, recognized workplace safety training, and PCQI designation is an asset.
  • Basic computer skills including Microsoft Office and sanitation tracking systems.


Why you should join our team:

  • Power of Collaboration: Live our core values - "Own it", "Care about it", "Make it exceptional", and "Win together" - as we work together to create better food for everyone, the Japanese way.
  • Competitive Rewards: Upon meeting eligibility criteria reap the benefits of a comprehensive compensation package with a bonus plan, group health benefits, and retirement plans that recognize your outstanding contribution.
  • Ignite Your Potential: Fuel your growth with extensive training and opportunities for career advancement, empowering you to unleash your full potential.
  • Champion Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We are committed to fostering a workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion thrive, empowering every voice to be heard and celebrated through meaningful initiatives and programs.
  • Drive Sustainable Impact: As part of our dedication to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles, we actively promote sustainable practices and initiatives to create a positive impact on our environment and communities.


For more information about Bento Sushi and our opportunities, please visit www.bentosushi.com.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however only those candidates elected for an interview will be contacted. Special consideration will be given to applicants with previous experience working as a; .Industrial Sanitation Supervisor, Food Manufacturing Sanitation, Sanitation Team Leader.

title: Propulsion Engineer, Test/Flight - Engine Test, BE-3U
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Blue Origin Engines business unit, where our focus is the design, development, manufacturing, and testing of engines and propulsion systems. Built for multiple uses, our family of engines is powering the next generation of rockets for commercial, civil, national security, and human spaceflight.

Propulsion Engineer III — BE-3U

Job Family: Propulsion Engineering | Discipline: Engine Integration Location: Renton, WA or Huntsville, AL

This role is part of the Blue Origin Engines business unit, where our focus is the design, development, manufacturing, and testing of engines and propulsion systems. Built for multiple uses, our family of engines is powering the next generation of rockets for commercial, civil, national security, and human spaceflight.

As part of a diverse and hardworking team of engineers, you will support the design, analysis, and test of BE-3U engine hardware and fluid systems across the development and production life cycle. Your daily responsibilities will include coordinating with a multidisciplinary team to develop test plans, performing steady-state and transient system analysis, supporting component and integrated engine testing, analyzing test data, and supporting Data Reviews and Test Readiness Reviews. Other tasks include generating test reports, supporting engine requirements verification, implementing opportunities for design and test cadence improvement, and supporting anomaly investigations as well as root cause analysis to drive corrective actions and hardware improvements.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Special Mentions

  • Relocation provided

  • Travel expected up to 10% of the time

  • Interviews will include a technical assessment

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of a B.S. degree in aerospace/mechanical engineering or physics

  • 5+ years of experience in propulsion design, analysis, or test

  • Strong understanding and ability to apply engineering fundamentals including thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and structures

  • Demonstrated familiarity with data analysis and data processing, including writing scripts in Python

  • In-depth knowledge of engine components including turbopumps, combustion chambers, injectors, valves, regulators, check valves, and other high pressure and cryogenic fluid system components

  • Strong knowledge of instrumentation including pressure transducers, thermocouples, and accelerometers

  • Strong understanding of cryogenic propellants including liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering standards, technical requirements, and drawings

  • Knowledge of systems engineering practices, including requirements development and verification

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical work and mentor other engineers

  • Proven track record to identify and handle risks in a sophisticated dynamic system

  • Curiosity to understand rocket engines at a component and system level

  • Desire to work in a cooperative, fast paced, and dynamic environment

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Willingness to travel to support on site testing

  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

Preferred Qualifications

  • M.S. degree or higher in aerospace/mechanical engineering

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine testing, other engines, or large component testing

  • Working knowledge of rocket engine cycles, engine system operations, verification process, and risk management

  • Experience taking a propulsion or fluid system design from concept through qualification

  • Experience leading anomaly investigations and formal root cause analysis

  • Experience in project planning and successful execution of projects to cost and schedule targets

WA applicants is $121,023.00 - $169,432.20

Other site ranges may differ

description:

Our mission is to make everyday eating extraordinary for our guests. We create a warm, welcoming, and memorable experience through exceptional, personal service. We’re looking for a leader who brings positive energy, strong character, and a commitment to excellence every day. We value teamwork, celebrate our shared success, and look forward to the impact you’ll make on our store, our team, and our community.

Our added benefits for joining The Fresh Market team

  • Team Member discount up to 40%
  • Early Earn Wage Access (You can access up to 50% (max $500) of your earned wages on-demand per pay period)
  • 401K contribution and company match
  • Financial Wellness Program
  • Personal time off and additional time off purchase plans are available
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance for individual, spouse, partner, and family
  • Discounts on pet insurance, daycare, event tickets, and many more.
About the Position:

Do you have a passion for food? Are you committed to delivering an excellent experience for guests? As a Meat & Seafood Department Lead, you’ll help bring our mission to life by supporting the Meat & Seafood Department Manager in making everyday eating extraordinary. You’ll assist in leading your team with care and purpose, ensuring every guest feels welcome, and every department looks its best. You’ll work side by side with your team and manager, teaching and coaching them to grow while celebrating their successes. You’ll keep things running smoothly, solve problems quickly, and step in as acting manager when needed. This role reports to the Department Manager and embodies a culture of leadership, hospitality, excellence, and teamwork. Previous meat-cutting experience is preferred in this role, including the use of knives, grinders, and meat saws.

The pay range for this position is $17.20 - $19.84 per hour.

What You'll Do:
  • Help monitor labor schedules to meet productivity and budget goals.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate inventory levels, minimizing shrink, and supporting ordering processes.
  • Act as a resource for team members and provide guidance in the manager’s absence.
  • Model and coach “Impeccable Hospitality” by actively engaging guests and creating positive experiences.
  • Help implement merchandising strategies and promotional plans to maximize sales and profitability.
  • Assist in analyzing department financial and performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with fellow department leaders to drive overall store success.
  • Leverage available technology to perform these tasks.
Availability:

This position requires the willingness to work a flexible schedule, including weekends, days, evenings, and holidays.

Qualifications:

At a minimum, what you’ll need:

  • 1+ years of progressive management experience in supermarkets, retail, restaurants, hotels, or general business.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop high-performing teams.
  • Proven ability to deliver an exceptional guest experience while achieving performance goals.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Basic proficiency with POS systems, scheduling tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Must be 21 years of age or older.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate’s degree in business, retail management, or related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in grocery, fresh food retail, hospitality, or high-volume specialty retail environment
  • Knowledge of inventory management systems and financial reporting.
  • Bilingual skills a plus.

Physical and Work Conditions:

  • Repetitive hand/arm movements, grasping, bending, reaching, ability to lift, push, or pull up to 50 pounds by oneself, and exposure to extreme temperatures.
  • Ability to use tools and equipment: knives, ladders, stepstools, box cutters, pallet jacks, and other equipment.
  • Required to spend long periods of time on their feet and stand or walk without a break (for up to 4 hours or as required by law).
  • Required to wear an approved hat, hair net, and/or beard guard, and personal protective equipment.

title: Lead Vertical Analyst
location: Bellandur, Bengaluru East, Bangalore Urban District, Karnataka, India
description:
About the Role

  • We are looking for a sharp, analytically rigorous, and highly organized professional to serve as Vertical Analyst and Data Analytics Lead within our Global Strategy Office, based in Bangalore. This is a hybrid role built for someone who can operate as a trusted right hand to senior leadership — orchestrating strategic priorities and cross-functional execution — while personally owning the data and market analysis that underpins every major decision.

Key Responsibilities

1. Pipeline Management & Vertical Mapping

  • Own end to end visibility of the global opportunity and project pipeline within sales force, ensuring accurate stage tracking, forecasting and reporting
  • Partner with sales and business development teams to monitor pipeline health, flag stalled opportunities and support forecast accuracy for leadership reviews.
  • Conduct structured mapping of focus verticals with particular emphasis on New Energy, Infrastructure and Heavy Equipment’s including account universe, key players, and competitive positioning
  • Collaborate with sales, business development and finance team to translate and map customers into an appropriate vertical as per industry development

2. Market Intelligence & Analyst

  • Personally own the analysis of large, multi-source datasets (sales, market, operational, financial) to surface trends, risks, and white-space opportunities.
  • Lead deep-dive market analysis on focus verticals such as Data Centers and adjacent high-growth infrastructure markets — sizing, segmentation, competitive dynamics, and demand signals.
  • Build and maintain executive-grade dashboards and models (Power BI, Tableau, advanced Excel) that leadership relies on for real-time decision-making.
  • Establish data governance and reporting standards so insight generation scales beyond any one individual or team.

3. Program & Portfolio Execution

  • Coordinate execution of the highest-priority global strategic initiatives, ensuring they stay on track, on budget, and aligned to leadership intent.
  • Maintain a portfolio-level view of strategic projects using tools such as Smartsheet, tracking interdependencies, risks, and resourcing gaps across regions.
  • Use Salesforce and other CRM/ERP data to connect market intelligence directly to commercial pipeline and account strategy.

4. Tools & Systems

  • Advanced proficiency in Smartsheet, Salesforce, Power BI or Tableau, and Excel; working familiarity with SAP or equivalent ERP systems.
  • Comfort building lightweight automations, templates, and self-serve dashboards that reduce manual reporting burden across the team.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 8–10 years of experience in business/data analytics, management consulting, or global program management, ideally within a large industrial, engineering, or manufacturing organization.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skill set, with hands-on experience in data analysis and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, advanced Excel).
  • Prior exposure to Data Center, Infrastructure, Industrial Automation, or related B2B verticals is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Smartsheet, Salesforce, and/or SAP or equivalent ERP/CRM platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Economics, or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced degree strongly preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Trusted, discreet, and comfortable operating close to senior leadership on sensitive matters
  • Analytically rigorous with a strong data-first instinct, but equally strong on execution and follow-through
  • Able to move fluidly between 30,000-foot strategy and detailed data work
  • High ownership and self-direction; thrives with broad, loosely defined mandates
  • Strong influence-without-authority skills across a global matrix organization

Success in the First 6 Months Looks Like

  • A functioning leadership operating rhythm (QBRs, strategy reviews) that the leadership team relies on
  • A live, trusted dashboard suite covering the Data Center vertical and 1–2 other focus areas
  • Demonstrated ability to turn a messy, ambiguous strategic question into a clear, data-backed recommendation within days, not weeks

What We Offer

  • Unusually proximity to senior leadership and enterprise-level decision-making
  • A role that blends strategy, analytics, and execution rather than confining you to one lane
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and a clear path to broader strategic role

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.

Who We Are

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.

Global Benefits & Perks
You’ll be rewarded with a competitive salary plus receive entitlements and benefits unique to your country of hire.

What You’ll Also Get

Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

Learning & Development:
Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).

Diverse & Inclusive Culture:
We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.

Purpose-Driven Company:
You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

title: Mold Specialist 2nd Shift
description:
Airlite Plastics is a premier, privately held, family-owned manufacturer headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. Our family style and personal culture is what makes Airlite an amazing place to grow and build a successful career. Airlite’s company values of unquestionable integrity and respect and appreciation for each other are at the core of our success! These values set a strong foundation to build on where we can ‘wow’ our customers with innovative products and sustainable solutions, and continuously improve our processes and efficiencies.

Our product lines include rigid plastic containers and lids for food packaging and cosmetics, dry powder scoops, plastic drink cups, shipping containers, industrial strength insulated concrete forms (ICF) and sustainable permeable paving systems. As pioneers in our industry, focused on sustainable solutions, we strive to provide our customers with top-notch service and quality, which aligns with our award-winning products.

How would you contribute?

This role is a contributing member of our Airlite - Omaha team, located in Omaha, NE. As a Mold Specialist you are a key to continued growth and success of Airlite. The Mold Specialist is responsible for the proper set up, operation and processing of high-speed injection molding machines and robots to produce high-quality parts efficiently; adjusts machine settings according to specifications to meet quality expectations. This role is responsible for maintaining quality, scrap and machine efficiencies in assigned area.

Essential Duties:

  • Perform machine start-up and shut down to required procedures.
  • Perform process troubleshooting to ensure part conformity and quality.
  • Evaluate product acceptability after completion of machine adjustments and/or color changes.
  • Review production schedule, make color, material and label changes during shift.
  • Review and perform floor inspection and diameter size check; report and follow up on items needing technical corrections.
  • Perform quality inspections and document product quality and color shades to ensure product is within specifications.
  • Communicate with quality auditors and/or Supervisors regarding questionable product and make timely adjustments.
  • Monitor and continually work toward reducing scrap on targeted machines.
  • Monitor cycle times to required procedures.
  • Maintain safety and housekeeping expectations, report potential machine or work hazards, respond immediately to emergency machine problems, and ensure the safety of co-workers within designated work area.
  • Collaborate with team members on new machines, mold, materials, processes and procedures.
  • Ensure effective transfer of information across shifts.
  • Prepare maintenance work orders and ensure compliance with Preventative Maintenance Programs.
  • Maintain accurate computer logs to include documenting adjustments, resolutions and support requested.
  • Maintain company attendance standards.
  • Report food safety concerns to management.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Do you have what it takes? Airlite Plastics is a versatile employer; complacency is not one of our strengths! We work hard each day to ensure that equipment efficiency and customer satisfaction never leave our line of sight. Successful candidates for the role will possess the following:

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:

  • Demonstrated mechanical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot mechanical issues.
  • Capability to utilize problem solving skills.
  • Good organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple projects/activities/goals.
  • Must be able to work well with others, build partnerships and support team members.
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and tactful in dealing with people at all levels.
  • Must be self-motivated and positive.
  • Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations.
  • Display highest ethical standards.
  • Maintain the utmost level of confidentiality in dealing with sensitive information.
  • Detail oriented, with the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic computer skills with the ability to operate Microsoft Office products.
  • Upholds and supports organizational goals and values.
  • Takes initiative and asks for help when needed.
  • Associate's degree (AA) or equivalent from two-year college or technical school is preferred
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing setting using processing skills is preferred.


Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role does not have personnel supervisory responsibilities; however, this role includes working with cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; stand; walk; use hand dexterity to operate office equipment including computer keyboards; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to walk; climb or balance; and stoop and kneel. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds with assistance. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is seasonally and moderately exposed to humid conditions and heat. The employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts, the risk of electrical shock and exposure to extreme molten plastic temperature. The employee is frequently exposed to height of 8-10 feet and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is loud.

JOB HAZARD ANALYSIS

All positions must have a current Job Hazard Analysis attached to the job description. See the JHA for Office Staff, located on the Company Intranet: Corporate Services> Safety> Job Hazard Analysis

Our Core Values Drive Us!

  • Do you conduct yourself with unquestionable integrity?
  • Do you demonstrate respect and appreciation for those around you?
  • Are you innovative and strive to challenge the status quo?
  • Do you strive for continuous improvement and to deliver the “wow” factor?
  • Do you care about environmentally sustainable solutions?
  • Do you take meaning and pride in a job well done?

What’s in it for you? As a Full-Time employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance
  • Company paid life insurance
  • Company paid short term disability
  • Generous 401k match
  • Generous Time Off
  • Annual company activities

title: Director of Operations
description:
About our company...

For over 49 years, Triple Crown Corporation has been a trusted name in the Greater Harrisburg area. With continued growth on the horizon, we're excited to keep raising the bar in quality craftsmanship and customer care for the communities we serve. We specialize in Property Management, Construction, Land Development, and Real Estate Services —delivering top-tier solutions to our valued partners, clients, and customers. As a full-service design-build company, we offer both commercial and residential expertise across Central PA and beyond.

About the position...

The Director of Operations will be responsible for providing companywide operational leadership in support of Triple Crown Corporation’s growth initiatives and Strategic Growth Plan. Working closely with the Executive Team and department leaders, this position helps translate organizational goals into effective operational strategies and practices. The Director provides insight and recommendations related to operations, organizational effectiveness, financial performance, and risk, while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen collaboration, and support the company’s continued growth and long-term success.

  • Partner with the Executive Team to develop, communicate, and execute company strategy and operational initiatives, providing insight into business performance, opportunities, and key operational challenges.
  • Provide overall leadership and oversight of company operations, ensuring policies, procedures, and operational practices are consistently implemented and aligned with organizational goals and values.
  • Drive execution of the company’s Strategic Growth Plan, establishing accountability across departments and ensuring initiatives and objectives are consistently advanced throughout the organization.
  • Evaluate and improve business processes and systems to increase efficiency, productivity, quality, and profitability, ensuring critical processes are documented, maintained, communicated, and effectively implemented.
  • Monitor operational and financial performance, partnering with leadership to review budgets, financial reports, and key performance indicators and make informed operational adjustments that support the company’s financial objectives.
  • Lead and develop department leaders, establishing clear expectations and accountability, conducting regular performance reviews and Key Result Area (KRA) meetings, and providing coaching, feedback, and support to strengthen leadership capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with the General Managers of Construction and Property Management to address operational challenges, support departmental initiatives, and ensure consistent execution of company objectives across both divisions.
  • Oversee companywide risk management, safety, and compliance initiatives, partnering with department leaders and committees to promote a safe, compliant, and risk-conscious workplace and business environment.
  • Champion employee engagement and organizational development in partnership with Human Resources, supporting effective recruiting, retention, recognition, performance management, training, employee feedback, and succession planning.
  • Oversee technology and business systems strategy, partnering with the CFO, IT, and functional leaders to ensure technology investments and systems support operational effectiveness, security, and the company’s long-term objectives.
  • Champion the customer experience and company brand, ensuring operational practices support high levels of customer satisfaction, while partnering with Marketing to maintain consistent, accurate, and effective company messaging.
  • Promote and reinforce the company’s People, Quality, Value culture, ensuring employees understand and align their actions and conduct with the company’s strategic objectives, values, and expectations.

What we are looking for from you...

  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience working in a Senior Operations role
  • Minimum of 5 years experience working in a management or leadership role
  • Experience in the Real Estate and/or Property Management industry is a plus
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Management, or related field is required
  • Professional certifications in personnel and/or management operations are highly valued
  • Leadership training such as decision making, corporate governance, change management, negotiation, strategic leadership, and business analysis are highly valued
  • Leads by example and sets a positive tone throughout the organization, confidently managing relationships with employees, suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders while balancing diverse needs and priorities
  • Excellent leadership, management, customer service and communication skills
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, and comfortable using mobile devices
  • Proficient in Yardi or other Property Management software is highly valued
  • Must possess a valid Driver’s License and reliable transportation

title: Patient Safety Associate I (Drug Safety Associate I)
location: Any Region, REMOTE, United States of America
description:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Patient Safety Associate I (Pharmacovigilance Associate, Drug Safety Associate) to join our team. This role supports critical patient safety and pharmacovigilance activities that help ensure the safe and compliant development of therapies for patients worldwide.

As a Patient Safety Associate I, you will contribute to a broad range of safety operations, including individual case safety report processing, safety submissions, literature review activities, affiliate support, regulatory support, and regulatory intelligence activities. Working within established procedures and under appropriate supervision, you will play an important role in maintaining compliance with global regulatory requirements and supporting the delivery of high quality patient safety services.

You will gain exposure to a wide range of pharmacovigilance processes while collaborating with experienced professionals across global teams. This role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in drug safety, regulatory compliance, and clinical research while contributing to activities that help protect patients and support the development of innovative therapies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor incoming safety reports from multiple sources and support timely processing of pharmacovigilance data.
  • Perform data entry, case creation, case processing, quality checks, coding activities, follow up activities, and case narrative preparation within safety databases in accordance with client requirements and standard operating procedures.
  • Support compliance with regulatory reporting requirements through accurate processing, documentation, reconciliation, and tracking of safety cases and submissions.
  • Conduct literature searches, screen and review scientific literature, identify potential safety information, and support literature monitoring activities.
  • Manage submission of Individual Case Safety Reports, periodic reports, and related documentation to regulatory authorities and other stakeholders.
  • Support affiliate services activities, including safety information exchange, literature screening coordination, translation support, follow up activities, and data reconciliation.
  • Maintain documentation, records, and project files in applicable systems, including EDMS and eTMF environments.
  • Support regulatory operations by maintaining regulatory databases, tracking submissions, supporting registrations, and assisting with lifecycle management activities.
  • Participate in regulatory intelligence activities by researching, maintaining, and updating country specific safety reporting requirements and associated records.
  • Participate in project meetings, training programs, audits, inspections, and other assigned departmental activities while escalating issues to supervisors as appropriate.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in organization, attention to detail, and analytical thinking.
  • An interest in pharmacovigilance, patient safety, pharmaceutical development, or healthcare environments.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with team members and communicate clearly.
  • A patient focused mindset and commitment to quality and compliance.
  • Experience working with pharmacovigilance systems, databases, Microsoft Office applications, and established workflows.
  • A strong desire to learn, develop new skills, and contribute to clinical research and patient safety initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Biomedical Sciences
    (e.g., Pharmacy, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology) or equivalent education/experience.
  • Foundational knowledge of drug safety regulations and pharmacovigilance processes. Ideal candidate has 3+ years experience in Drug Safety.
  • 2+ years experience in post marketing.
  • Experience in multiple therapeutic areas (cardiology, neurology, oncology, rare disease).
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and problem solving ability.
  • Effective communication and willingness to work in a collaborative team environment.
  • Proficiency with MS Office and ability to learn safety systems/databases. Preference for those with Veeva Safety experience.

Benefits and Compensation

  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Vacation/Holiday/Sick Time
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
  • Work/Life Balance
  • 401(k) with Company match

title: Data Engineer
description:
Build the data products that power smarter banking

Data plays a critical role in shaping the future of banking. At ING, we're looking for a Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges, building scalable data solutions, and collaborating with teams across the globe.

If you're passionate about designing modern data platforms, working with cutting-edge technologies, and helping transform data into business value, this could be the opportunity you're looking for.

Role Summary

As a Data Engineer within our Data Management Tribe, you will design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-performing data solutions that support business-critical data products across ING. You'll work across the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and transformation to storage, modeling, and consumption.

Working closely with Product Owners, Data Analysts, Software Engineers, and technical leads, you'll help deliver reliable and efficient data capabilities that enable better decision-making across the organization.

This is a permanent mid-to-senior level opportunity for professionals who enjoy working in an international environment and are motivated by technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

About the Team

The Data Management Tribe enables trusted, accessible, and scalable data solutions across ING's banking and financial services landscape. You'll join a collaborative team of engineers and data professionals who are passionate about creating impactful data products and advancing data capabilities.

Our teams work closely with global stakeholders across multiple countries, providing opportunities to collaborate internationally, share knowledge, and contribute to large-scale initiatives that drive meaningful business outcomes.

You'll also benefit from an engineering culture that promotes innovation, learning, knowledge-sharing, and professional growth.

Required Skills

We're looking for candidates who bring experience in:

  • Python development and data engineering practices

  • SQL, relational databases, and NoSQL databases

  • Data warehousing, data modeling, and data architecture

  • Building and maintaining ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines

  • Data ingestion, transformation, storage, and processing solutions

  • Software quality practices and data pipeline testing

  • CI/CD, DevOps practices, automation, and scripting

  • Working with distributed and cross-functional teams

It would be advantageous if you have experience with:

  • Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP

  • Streaming technologies including Kafka or Flink

  • Spark and large-scale data processing environments

  • Docker and Kubernetes

  • Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle databases

We're particularly interested in individuals with strong problem-solving capabilities, a solution-oriented mindset, and a passion for building high-quality data products.

What We Offer

At ING, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on impactful data products within a global banking organization

  • Collaborate with international teams and stakeholders across multiple markets

  • Build solutions using modern data technologies and engineering practices

  • Contribute to innovation initiatives that help shape the future of data within ING

  • Learn from experienced engineers through knowledge-sharing communities and technical collaboration

  • Grow your career through development opportunities, certifications, and continuous learning

  • Join an inclusive, supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and professional growth

Equal Employment Opportunity

Worried about the wage gap? So are we. Our commitment to pay equity means you'll be valued for your skills, not your gender.

Job Application Safety Reminder ⚠️

We're seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

  • Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site.

  • Check the sender's email carefully: legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com

  • No payments or banking details will ever be requested. If someone asks for this information, it's a scam.

ING empowers people and businesses to stay a step ahead in life and in business. Join us and help build the data foundations that enable better banking experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

title: Proposal & RFP Specialist
description:
Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.


Magna Legal Services is seeking an experienced proposal professional to independently manage our end-to-end RFP response process, from initial intake and planning through final submission. You will support opportunities across Magna’s full range of service lines and client types, including law firms, corporate legal departments, insurance carriers, and government agencies.

RFP volume naturally fluctuates. During active periods, you may manage several concurrent proposals spanning different service lines and buyer types. Outside of active submissions, you will own the infrastructure that makes future responses faster and stronger, including our content and credential libraries, case studies, templates, competitive insights, and proposal processes.

This is an established, full-time area of ownership rather than an entry-level or rotational assignment. You will report directly to the Director of Sales Operations and work with significant autonomy while coordinating closely with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Legal, IT, HR, and subject-matter experts across the business.

Primary Responsibilities

Proposal Development and Submission

  • Own the full lifecycle of RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, including intake, requirement analysis, project planning, drafting, review coordination, quality assurance, and final submission.
  • Review solicitation materials, identify mandatory requirements, and create compliance matrices and workback schedules.
  • Draft and edit tailored, persuasive responses across Magna’s service lines, including court reporting and deposition services, jury consulting and research, trial graphics and presentation services, medical record retrieval and review, and language and interpreting services.
  • Adapt each response to the buyer’s priorities, recognizing that law firms, corporate legal departments, insurance carriers, and government agencies have different evaluation criteria, compliance requirements, and procurement processes.
  • Interview subject-matter experts and business leaders to translate complex operational and technical information into clear, differentiated proposal content.
  • Coordinate input and approvals related to pricing, staffing, legal terms, data security, compliance, technology, and implementation.
  • Independently manage standard proposal content, including company overviews, service descriptions, staff biographies and credentials, case studies, implementation approaches, and past-performance examples.
  • Manage document formatting, version control, review cycles, and submission logistics.
  • Ensure every response complies with stated requirements, including page limits, required forms, attachments, certifications, and portal-submission instructions.
  • Maintain accurate records of proposal activity, deadlines, submissions, outcomes, and client feedback.

Content and Credential Management

  • Build and maintain a centralized, searchable library of approved proposal content.
  • Interview consultants and service-line leaders following significant matters to develop compelling case studies and past-performance examples.
  • Maintain current biographies, credentials, certifications, and relevant experience for employees and consultants featured in proposals.
  • Review and refresh company overviews, service descriptions, methodologies, and differentiators on a regular schedule.
  • Retire outdated content and confirm that reusable materials remain accurate, consistent, and approved.

Process Improvement and Proposal Operations

  • Build and maintain reusable templates by client type, service line, and solicitation type.
  • Standardize the intake and subject-matter-expert interview processes to improve response speed and content quality.
  • Document a repeatable intake-to-submission playbook that supports consistency and backup coverage.
  • Evaluate proposal-management tools and help recommend and implement a scalable solution.
  • Identify recurring bottlenecks and introduce practical improvements to the proposal-development process.

Performance and Market Insights

  • Lead internal debriefs following key wins and losses and capture available feedback.
  • Track proposal volume, turnaround time, outcomes, and recurring reasons for wins or losses.
  • Capture relevant competitor and market insights from public sources, bid feedback, and internal debriefs.
  • Maintain knowledge of the evaluation priorities and procurement practices associated with each major client segment.
  • Monitor relevant government and insurance bid portals for potential opportunities.
  • Maintain a 60–90-day calendar of known and anticipated RFP activity and identify opportunities that require early subject-matter input, pricing support, or new case studies.

Adjacent Commercial Content

  • Repurpose approved proposal content into capability statements, one-pagers, case studies, and other Sales or business-development materials.
  • Partner with Marketing and Commercial Operations to ensure consistent messaging across proposals and client-facing content.

Desired Background

Required Qualifications
  • At least three years of hands-on experience writing and managing RFP, RFI, or RFQ responses in a professional-services or similarly compliance-driven environment.
  • Experience independently managing multiple concurrent proposals from intake through submission.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and information-synthesis skills, with the judgment to write persuasively while remaining accurate and strictly compliant.
  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to secure timely input and decisions from busy stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and quality control.
  • Ability to learn and write credibly across multiple complex or technical service lines.
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment and managing a workload that fluctuates around proposal deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Adobe Acrobat.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in legal services, litigation support, insurance, government contracting, or another professional-services environment.
  • Experience responding to government solicitations or working with electronic bid portals.
  • Experience with proposal-management platforms such as Loopio, Responsive, or QorusDocs.
  • Experience building or improving content libraries, templates, and proposal workflows.

title: Video Backend Support Engineer
description:
The Video Support Engineer is part of the team responsible for the monitoring, first-line support, and operational continuity of TOD — our OTT encoding and video delivery platform, spanning origin, multi-CDN delivery, packaging, and the video backend. Working shift-based coverage aligned to the live-event calendar (including live sports on evenings and weekends either remote or on site/Hybrid), you keep video services healthy during events, detect and triage issues, execute operational runbooks, and escalate to engineering and vendors when needed. You also help keep runbooks, reference material, and incident records accurate so the team's operational knowledge improves over time.

Responsibilities

- Monitor the health and performance of TOD encoding and video delivery systems — origin, CDN, packaging, and delivery — during and around live and VOD events.

- Provide shift-based operational coverage aligned to the live-event calendar, ensuring services are watched during high-traffic windows.

- Detect, triage, and resolve first-line incidents using operational runbooks; carry out known fixes and configuration steps within defined procedures.

- Monitor viewer experience (QoE) and act on degradations in startup time, rebuffering, and playback errors.

- Escalate to engineering and to third-party vendors (Harmonic, Unified Streaming, Akamai, and others) when an issue is beyond first-line scope, and follow escalations through to resolution.

- Support CMS and video back-end related issues in coordination with engineering.

- Record all incidents in the incident reporting system, and contribute findings to post-incident reviews to prevent recurrence and improve future response.

- Ensure clean handover and hand-back of live systems, confirming services are fully operational before returning them to live use.

- Help keep runbooks, reference pages, and operational documentation current, flagging gaps to the responsible engineers.

- Complete assigned tasks to a high standard within agreed timeframes, coordinating with the team on planned and unplanned activities.


Requirements

Qualifications

- University degree in Electronic, Electronics & Communications, Computer, or a related engineering field.

- Min.3 years experience in broadcast systems, digital television, or OTT environments.

- Understanding of video standards and formats — SD/HD/UHD, MPEG-TS, HLS, DASH.

- Understanding of CDN-based content delivery with providers such as Akamai, CloudFront, or similar.

- Experience with OTT video backend systems such as Harmonic VOS360, AWS Elemental, Unified Streaming and Ateme Titan.

- Understanding of DRM technologies (PlayReady, Widevine, FairPlay).

- Experience with monitoring and QoE tools such as Conviva, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Telestream, or TAG.

- Basic scripting ability (Shell, Python) for operational tasks and automation.

- Good understanding of the demands of a live, automated broadcast environment.

- Comfortable working from runbooks and following structured operational procedures.

- Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience with runbooks, PIR processes, vendor escalation, and Jira.

- Fluent in English; able to drive readiness across teams without direct authority.

- Preferred: Harmonic VOS360, Akamai, dashboarding (Grafana/ELK), SSAI/ad insertion, or live sports streaming experience.

Job Title:

Senior Specialist, Supply Chain

Job Description:

The Role

Entegris is seeking an experienced Senior Specialist, Supply Chain to manage and resolve supply chain escalations within the Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) Division. In this role, you will partner with global planning, manufacturing, and operations teams to identify and address material shortages, cross‑plant constraints, and delivery risks across the end‑to‑end supply chain. You will proactively analyze data, develop contingency plans, and communicate risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to key stakeholders and senior leaders, while representing the Global Supply Planning team in daily operations, production escalations, and leadership forums.

This position reports to the Director of Global Supply Chain Planning and will primarily support the Gas Micro Contamination business. This position may be based out of San Luis Obispo, CA, Billerica, MA, Chaska, MN, or Colorado Springs, CO.

What You'll Do:

  • Identify and resolve any shortages and cross-plant issues or delays within the supply chain process maintaining a end-to-end perspective.

  • Develop contingency action plans to address potential supply chain disruptions to be proactive. Communicate risk, tradeoffs, and scenarios to stakeholders and leadership.

  • Represent the Global Supply Planning team during operations planning processes, daily production escalations, and senior leadership report outs and working sessions.

  • Manage and monitor supply chain operations to ensure timely and efficient delivery of products.

  • Analyze supply chain data and performance to identify areas for improvement. This includes enhancing ERP setting and Power BI partnering with the COE.

  • Coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, and distributors to ensure smooth operations.

  • Develop and implement supply chain strategies to reduce costs and improve efficiency.

  • Work on a global team and leverage best practices amongst each other to ensure personal and team development and success.

  • Create and maintain detailed reports on supply chain performance metrics.

  • Collaborate with different departments to align supply chain activities with overall business goals.

  • 5-7 years’ supply chain management experience;

  • Bachelor’s Degree; preferably in Business, Supply Chain or Industrial Distribution;

  • Proficient use of Microsoft Excel and/or Access, and developing or operating in complex databases; ability to analyze data and turn data into information and action

  • Ability to apply statistical methods to supply chain and inventory related concepts (using SPC concept to assign upper and lower target stocking levels, using Mean Average Deviation or Standard Deviation to establish safety stock levels)

  • Effective people skills (Communicate, Influence and champion change);

  • Knowledge and hands on experience in SAP MRP/ERP required;

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive accountability across peers as well as leading cross-functional teams;

  • Effective problem solving / critical thinking skills to drive solutions related to complex supply chain models and characteristics;

  • Excellent decision-making ability with the confidence to implement those decisions;

location: Round Lake, Illinois, United States of America
description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your role at Baxter

At Baxter, your work helps drive innovation that improves and saves lives. As an Associate Scientist II within R&D, you'll play a critical role in solving complex technical challenges that support product quality, manufacturing excellence, and new product development. Leveraging advanced microscopy and analytical techniques, you'll investigate root causes, identify particles and materials, and generate insights that influence decisions across our global organization.

You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across R&D, Quality, and Manufacturing while building expertise in cutting-edge characterization methods and therapeutic product knowledge.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and execute laboratory investigations focused on particle identification, failure analysis, root cause investigations, and manufacturing process capability.

  • Design and perform experiments independently, applying scientific principles and analytical techniques to solve both routine and complex technical challenges.

  • Utilize advanced microscopy and spectroscopy tools to characterize materials, identify particles, and support product and process development initiatives.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams across global R&D, Quality, and Manufacturing organizations to drive scientific solutions and continuous improvement.

  • Evaluate data, interpret results, and provide sound technical recommendations that influence project direction and business decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve existing analytical approaches, methodologies, and processes through innovative thinking and emerging technologies.

  • Contribute to feasibility assessments and technical evaluations for new research concepts, products, and process improvements.

  • Ensure all research activities, documentation, and reporting meet applicable quality, safety, and regulatory requirements, including GxP standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience with analytical and characterization techniques such as:

    • Stereomicroscopy

    • Polarized Light Microscopy (PLM)

    • Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM)

    • Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS)

    • Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR)

    • Raman Spectroscopy

  • Strong scientific problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • A collaborative mindset with the ability to contribute effectively within cross-functional project teams.

  • Intellectual curiosity and a passion for learning new technologies, methods, and scientific approaches.

  • Excellent communication and technical writing skills.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline with 3+ years of relevant industry experience; or

  • Master's degree or higher in a related scientific field.

Why Baxter?

Join a team where your expertise in microscopy and particle science directly impacts product quality, patient safety, and innovation. You'll have the opportunity to work with advanced analytical technologies, partner with experts across the organization, and contribute to solutions that make a meaningful difference for patients worldwide.
