title: Instrument Service Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated GxP lab service professional to serve as the single point of accountability for Laboratory Instrument Support (LIS) third-party instrument service activity within our customer’s clinical manufacturing laboratories in Upper Merion, PA. The successful candidate will provide hosting and execution-level communications with vendors performing instrument services, customer scheduling coordination, GxP documentation flow, and frontline instrument triage.
Beyond compliance coordination, the Coordinator also delivers day-to-day operational support for laboratory instruments: performing routine user-level calibrations and basic troubleshooting to resolve common issues without vendor dispatch, and GxP-adapted operational readiness tasks (e.g., equipment cleaning, consumable restocking, safety walks). Each day, the Coordinator boosts laboratory productivity, protects GxP/GMP compliance posture.

In addition to serving as the primary in-lab host for instrument service activity, the LIS GxP Instrument Service Coordinator's responsibilities include:

Vendor Hosting & Real-Time Oversight

  • Serve as the primary in-lab host for all third-party (multivendor OEM) instrument service activities, providing 100% vendor escorting in accordance with customer requirements.

  • Facilitate vendor onboarding, lab walkthroughs, and point-of-use oversight; enforce customer service expectations and lab safety requirements in real time, at the point of execution.

  • Act as the onsite authority aligning vendor engineers with scientific staff during service execution.

Scheduling, Communication & Asset Coordination

  • Act as the single coordination interface across workflow schedulers, external vendors, customer operations, and end users; sequence service activity to minimize instrument downtime and operational disruption.

  • Maintain a shared, status tracker so vendor and service status is visible to stakeholders.

  • Proactively confirm pre-work readiness (materials, access, approvals) prior to vendor arrival.

GxP Compliance Execution

  • Enforce GxP and GMP compliance baselines during all service activities; execute logbook/ELN entries contemporaneously with service completion.

  • Own calibration sticker placement and accuracy; coordinate collection, review, and routing of vendor field service documentation supporting equipment release.

  • Support interpretation and application of “as found / as left” expectations in coordination with Quality Assurance.

Frontline Triage & Day-to-Day Operational Support

  • Provide frontline failure triage for all managed assets: assess failure, classify urgency, take corrective action where feasible, and determine escalation path prior to vendor or specialist dispatch.

  • Perform routine user-level calibrations (e.g., pipettes, pH meters) and basic troubleshooting to resolve common instrument issues and reduce reliance on vendor engagement for low-complexity service needs.

  • Complete structured triage documentation prior to escalation, providing responding engineers complete and accurate failure context to eliminate redundant diagnostics.

  • Perform certain GxP-adapted operational readiness tasks (e.g., microplate autoclaving, routine equipment cleaning, consumable restocking/replacement, monthly safety walks).

Continuity, Administration & Process Support

  • Cross-train a designated backup resource to provide continuity coverage for non-GxP vendor hosting, escorting, and scheduling coordination.

  • Complete administrative paperwork and computer reports promptly and accurately.

  • Be responsive to customer requests for service; communicate proactively before, during, and after service events.

  • Aid leadership in writing, revising, and/or implementing processes and procedures supporting the service coordination model.

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job at any time.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of GxP/GMP regulatory requirements and documentation practices (e.g., logbooks, calibration records, as found/as left conventions).

  • Hands-on skill performing routine user-level instrument calibrations and troubleshooting (e.g., pipettes, pH meters, balances) to resolve common issues without vendor dispatch.

  • Ability to perform frontline user troubleshooting and problem solving, including triage and escalation decisions, when direct technical training is limited.

  • Technical writing, with the ability to complete and review compliance documentation accurately and on schedule.

  • Exceptional interpersonal and coaching skills to train and cross-train backup coverage resources.

  • Experience using Microsoft Suite (i.e., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel) and electronic logbook/MES systems (e.g., Syncade).

  • Effective communicator (e.g., audits, inspections, speaking with leadership across PerkinElmer and customer).

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and prioritize conflicting deadlines across multiple vendors and stakeholders.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with international counterparts to achieve global objectives.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Technical, Life Sciences, or a related Science field with 3+ year(s) of hands-on experience in a GxP/GMP-regulated laboratory, quality, or scientific equipment service environment OR

  • Associate’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Business, Technical, or Life Sciences with 5+ year(s) of relevant hands-on laboratory instrument operations, quality/compliance, or equipment service experience OR

  • High School Diploma (or equivalent) with 7+ year(s) of experience in a GxP/GMP-regulated laboratory, quality/compliance, or scientific equipment service environment, including direct vendor coordination, hands-on instrument troubleshooting, or compliance documentation responsibility.

The annual compensation range for this full-time position is $70,000 to $90,000. The final base pay offered to the successful candidate will be determined by factors including internal equity, work location, as well as individual qualifications, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Bijbaan Customer Relations medewerker
description:
Jij wordt onze nieuwe collega, dat weten we zeker! Als Customer Relations medewerker zorg jij ervoor dat onze klanten onze winkel áltijd met een grote glimlach verlaten. Welke vraag jou ook gesteld wordt, jij hebt de beste oplossing. De ene dag ben je het eerste gezicht dat de klant ziet, de andere dag het laatste. Je hebt 1 doel. En dat is de klant een super goede winkelervaring bezorgen. En dat doe je 12 uur per week bij IKEA Duiven.

Wat je dagelijkse werkzaamheden zullen zijn

Onze klanten komen niet alleen voor een nieuwe kledingkast. Ze willen ook een gezellig dagje weg. En jij levert daar een grote bijdrage aan. Je werkdagen zijn elke dag anders en dat maakt deze functie extra uitdagend. Dat komt omdat je binnen onze afdeling ingezet kan worden aan de kassa, klantenservice, receptie, uitgifte goederen en Småland. Wat je onder andere gaat doen:

• Bij de kassa klanten helpen met afrekenen
• Bij onze klantenservice de feedback van klanten op een positieve manier verwerken, jij denkt altijd mee in oplossingen.
• Nauwlettend de veiligheid van de kinderen in Småland in de gaten houden. Hoe gezellig de drukte tussen alle rondrennende kinderen ook is.
• Fysiek werk verrichten doordat je veel op je benen staat, artikelen in je handen hebt én zorgt dat de shoppingtools beschikbaar zijn voor onze klanten

Ons team binnen IKEA

Kan je het je voorstellen? IKEA begon ooit als klein postorderbedrijf in Älmhult, een Zweeds dorp op het platteland. Tegenwoordig vind je ons in 63 landen met een uniek assortiment. Werken bij IKEA, betekent werken in een wereld aan ideeën. Een wereld die door onze eigen collega’s wordt omschreven als een werkplek waar iedereen welkom is en je jezelf kan zijn. Waar we met elkaar het verschil maken voor zoveel mogelijk mensen en de planeet. Maar ook een werkplek waar je zelf je carrièrestappen bepaalt en waar veel ruimte is voor jouw praktische creativiteit en ideeën. En dat alles terwijl je werkt in een fijn team met collega’s die altijd voor je klaarstaan en je helpen wanneer dat nodig is.

Wie je bent

Met jouw inlevingsvermogen en klantgerichtheid zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten vertrouwen houden in onze mooie IKEA-producten en blijven terugkomen. Hoe druk het ook is, jij laat je niet gek maken. Je werkt snel en verliest daarbij niet de kwaliteit van jouw service uit het oog. Op de momenten dat het iets rustiger is in de winkel kijk je waar je klanten extra blij mee kan maken. Wat je nog meer nodig hebt:

• Weinig of veel werkervaring: het maakt ons niet uit, als je alles maar wilt leren. Klanten helpen en verzorgen is het allerbelangrijkst.
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, je vindt het leuk om contact te hebben met klanten en collega’s. Je bent meedenkend en stressbestendig.
• De wil om alles te leren over goede servicegerichtheid en klantcontact.

Verder kan je 12 uur per week werken. Bij IKEA werken we flexibel, zodat we er zijn op de momenten die er toe doen voor onze klanten. In deze rol werk je daarom vooral in de avonden doordeweeks en in het weekend.
Je diensten starten doordeweeks vanaf 17:00 uur en eindigen uiterlijk om 22:00 uur. Op zaterdag kan je dienst ingepland worden tussen 08:00 en 20:00 uur en op zondag tussen 08:00 en 19:00 uur. We vinden het belangrijk dat werk en privé in balans zijn, daarom kun je twee doordeweekse avonden blokkeren waarop je niet wordt ingepland. Je rooster stemmen we af op jouw beschikbaarheid en aantal werkdagen dat past bij jouw contracturen. Je weet het altijd 4 weken van tevoren.

Goed voor onze aarde én voor jou

Wat we vandaag doen, gaan we morgen weer iets beter doen. Want samen zorgen we voor de mens en het milieu. En IKEA zorgt ondertussen ook goed voor jou. Start als Customer Relations medewerker en ontvang op basis van 12 uur per week:

• Vanaf 18 jaar ontvang je afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring een all-in uurloon vanaf €17,74 per uur. Dit uurloon is inclusief een 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld. Deze worden standaard in december en mei uitbetaald, maar je kunt er ook voor kiezen om deze maandelijks te ontvangen.
• Een collectieve bonusregeling. Deze wordt jaarlijks vastgesteld en bedraagt maximaal 150% van je bruto maandsalaris.
• Reiskosten voor het openbaar vervoer worden 100% vergoed. Woon je binnen een straal van 5 tot 20 km van de IKEA-vestiging? Dan kan je ook kiezen voor een leasefiets. Reis je toch met de auto? Dan krijg je een tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten tot maximaal 243 euro per maand.
• 15% personeelskorting bij alle IKEA-winkels in Nederland.
• Diverse regelingen die passen bij jouw persoonlijke situatie. Denk hierbij aan transitieverlof en gelijk (100% doorbetaald) geboorteverlof ongeacht de samenstelling van je gezin. Ook mag je de in Nederland geldende feestdagen met niet-christelijke feestdagen ruilen. En elke winkel heeft een stilte-/gebedsruimte.

En nog veel meer! Benieuwd? Check onderaan deze vacature de link naar alle arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Kom werken in een wereld aan ideeën

Ben je enthousiast geworden over de functie en zie jij jezelf in deze rol? Fantastisch! Upload je CV en motivatiebrief en solliciteer vandaag nog.

description:
The Maintenance Director is responsible for planning, organizing, developing, and directing the overall operation of the maintenance department in accordance with current federal, state, and local regulations and established company policies and procedures. Ensure the facility is well-maintained in a safe and comfortable manner.

A. Role Responsibilities – Job Knowledge/Duties:

1. Manages the operations of the Maintenance Department by adhering to proper staffing and scheduling of personnel

2. Inspect storage rooms, work rooms, utility/janitorial closets, etc for upkeep and supply control

3. Participates in facility surveys made by authorized governmental agencies

4. Ensures that outside services are properly completed/supervised in accordance with contracts/work orders

5. Assists in establishing a preventative maintenance program

6. Meets with maintenance personnel on a regular basis and solicit advice from inter-department supervisors concerning the operation of the maintenance department, assist in identifying and correcting problem areas and /or improvement of services

7. Assists in identifying, evaluating, and classifying routine and job related maintenance functions to ensure that tasks involving the potential exposure to blood/body fluids are properly identified and recorded

8. Makes daily rounds to assure that maintenance personnel are performing required duties and assure that appropriate maintenance procedures are being rendered to meet the needs of the facility

9. Maintains fire alarm and other fire protection and preventive systems

10. Completes carpentry and other building repairs within the scope of expertise

11. Maintains heating and cooling systems

12. Makes some electrical and plumbing repair within scope of expertise

13. Monitors, maintains, and records inventory and orders supplies as needed, ensures supplies are available

14. Heads snow and ice removal for the sidewalks

15. When required, is on call seven days a week, 24 hours a day for emergencies

16. Other duties as required by the Administrator

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

1. Must possess, as a minimum, a high school education or its equivalent

2. Must have, as a minimum, one year experience in a supervisory capacity, in a maintenance related position

3. Must have a valid driver’s license

4. Must be able to withstand inside and outside environmental conditions, extreme heat, freezing conditions, and a noisy, dirty, dusty, or greasy work environment at times

5. Must be knowledgeable of boilers, compressors, generators, etc., as well as various mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems

6. Must be knowledgeable in building codes and safety regulations

7. Must be licensed in accordance with current applicable standards, codes, labor laws, etc.

8. Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language

9. Must be knowledgeable of maintenance practices and procedures, as well as the laws, regulations, and guidelines governing maintenance functions in the facility

10. Must possess leadership ability and ability to work in teams

11. Must possess the ability to plan and carry out programs in repair, new construction, and equipment installation

title: Senior Counsel
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Counsel

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we are helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payment choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Overview

Mastercard is seeking an experienced senior lawyer to provide comprehensive, end-to-end strategic legal support to the Core Payments business across Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EEMEA). The role will serve as a senior legal partner to regional Core Payments leadership, helping shape business strategy, product development, commercialization and region-wide pricing initiatives.

The successful candidate will be a payments- and technology-minded lawyer with strong executive presence, sound commercial judgment and extensive product and transactional experience. The role requires the ability to engage at both strategic and tactical levels, anticipate legal and regulatory issues, influence decision-making and translate complex risks into clear, practical guidance.

The Role

Act as a trusted strategic advisor to EEMEA Core Payments leadership and relevant regional and global stakeholders on business priorities, product strategy, commercialization models and material legal and reputational risks.

Provide strategic legal oversight across the lifecycle of Core Payments products and initiatives, from concept, design and regional assessment through market enablement, launch, scaling, enhancement and discontinuation.

Lead the legal review of EEMEA-wide Core Payments pricing and interchange initiatives, including the legal assessment of proposed pricing models, fee constructs, bundling, opt-in and opt-out structures, customer impact, communications and implementation considerations.

Advise on the legal and regulatory dimensions of pricing proposals and provide clear, risk-balanced recommendations to inform relevant regional and global governance and approval processes.

Shape regional legal positions and guardrails for complex or novel Core Payments initiatives, promoting consistency across EEMEA while recognizing market-specific legal and regulatory requirements.

Provide strategic challenge to business proposals, identify alternatives and controls, and help senior stakeholders make well-informed decisions in areas of legal uncertainty or heightened regulatory attention.

Lead or coordinate high-profile, cross-border and sensitive matters, including engagement with senior business leaders, specialist counsel, market legal teams and external counsel.

Key Responsibilities

Support Core Payments portfolios across EEMEA, including consumer products, core network and processing solutions, digital payments, authentication, tokenization, card products, cardholder solutions and related commercialization initiatives.

Partner closely with regional Core Payments leadership, pricing, finance, global product, sales, business development, customer delivery, technology, franchise, regulatory, compliance, privacy, intellectual property, public policy, communications and market business and legal teams.

Assess strategic pricing proposals for legal, competition, consumer protection, regulatory, contractual and reputational considerations, and coordinate market-specific analysis where required.

Guide the development of defensible rationales, customer propositions, contractual frameworks and communications for new or revised fees, product bundles and regional pricing programs.

Advise on product constructs, customer journeys, commercial models, go-to-market strategies, contracting structures and allocation of legal and operational responsibilities.

Oversee or handle complex commercial and technology agreements, including customer, partnership, vendor and platform arrangements, product terms, enrollment forms, addenda and statements of work.

Lead regional legal assessments, legal scans and product governance processes, and ensure timely coordination with market counsel and legal subject-matter experts.

Build strong relationships with global product counsel and other regions, promote alignment of legal positions, and adapt global frameworks and templates for EEMEA implementation.

Develop scalable legal frameworks, playbooks, templates and training that improve consistency, transparency and speed of execution across EEMEA.

Provide senior-level guidance, coaching and quality oversight to lawyers and legal resources supporting Core Payments matters, without implying formal people-management responsibility.

Manage external counsel strategically and efficiently, including scoping, selection, instruction, quality oversight and budget management.

Escalate material issues appropriately and ensure compliance with Mastercard policies, governance standards and record-keeping requirements.

All About You

Qualified senior lawyer in one or more jurisdictions, with a strong academic and professional training background.

Extensive experience in payments, financial services, fintech, technology, product and commercial legal matters, preferably gained through a combination of in-house and leading private-practice experience.

Demonstrated record of providing strategic legal advice to senior business leaders and influencing complex, high-impact decisions across multiple jurisdictions.

Strong understanding of payment networks, product development, commercialization and pricing. Experience reviewing pricing, fee or interchange initiatives is highly advantageous.

Sophisticated knowledge of competition, consumer protection, financial services regulation and contractual risk as they relate to payment products and pricing structures, with the judgment to coordinate specialist advice where necessary.

Advanced drafting and negotiation skills, including experience with complex technology, customer, vendor, partnership and product agreements.

Ability to understand complex products, data flows, technologies and economic models, identify the issues that matter and develop pragmatic, risk-balanced solutions.

Excellent executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the credibility to advise, challenge and influence senior legal and business leadership.

Proven ability to lead cross-functional and cross-border matters in a dynamic matrix environment, manage ambiguity and deliver under competing priorities and tight deadlines.

Collaborative, curious, proactive and solutions-oriented, with sound judgment, high integrity and strong attention to detail.

Fluency in English is required. Additional EEMEA language capability is an advantage.

Working Style and Scope

This role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and supports stakeholders across EEMEA. The role requires collaboration across jurisdictions and time zones and may involve business travel. Mastercard roles evolve with the needs of the business, and the responsibilities above are intended as a guide rather than an exhaustive list.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The Clinical Research Lead works locally to ensure country goals for recruitment and completion of key R&D sponsor deliverables are met.

Main Responsibilities

  • Oversee local CRO activities, acting as Single Point of Contact for key and strategic outsourced clinical studies, to ensure corporate and country objectives are reached and potential country issues properly followed-up.

  • Collaborate and liaise with Clinical Study Teams and Global Monitoring, for Sponsor’s clinical studies conducted within country, ensuring key project milestones and high quality are delivered.

  • Carry out top Level feasibilities, to collect key information on competitive clinical studies, marketed and non-marketed drugs, regulatory concerns, Standard of care, etc

  • Build up professional relationship with the investigators and Key Opinion Leaders.

  • Support the Global Monitoring team to conduct co-monitoring and CRA assessment visits, when needed and requested.

  • Act as a Site Relationship Partner for specific studies, to build and retain relationships through the lifecycle of the clinical study, to ensure an effective clinical study conduction and completion.

  • Act in accordance with company policies and procedures, SOPs, ICH/GCP guidelines, FDA regulations and local regulatory bodies.

  • Collaborates and interact with Medical Affairs Department, QA, Global Monitoring, clinical Study Start-Up teams, Global Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs), Global Regulatory and other as work needs.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 5 years’ clinical research experience as CRA or Lead CRA or Project Manager.

  • Effective organizational and time management skills.

title: Engineering & Reliability Lead
description:
Engineering & Reliability Lead

Location: Heler Foods Packing – Minffordd
Salary: £53,000 DOE
Contract: Full Time | Permanent

At Heler Foods, our people are part of our extended Heler Family — the driving force behind everything we do. From crafting award-winning cheeses to delivering service that sets new standards, we work together to shape the future of food.

CHEESEMAKERS. FUTURE SHAPERS. CHANGEMAKERS.

Rooted in tradition and growing into the future, we’re bold, ambitious and proud of where we’re going next.

Every colleague has a voice here — and every step you take helps move us forward.

Proud to be one of the UK’s leading cheese packing facilities, with BRC AA accreditation and Red Tractor certification, Heler Foods Packing sets the standard for quality in every block, slice and portion we pack.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a proactive and people-focused Engineering & Reliability Lead to join our team at Minffordd.

This is a key operational role within our Engineering function, responsible for making sure our engineering priorities are clearly understood, effectively coordinated and delivered.

Working closely with Production, Shift Engineering, Asset Care and the Reliability Manager, you’ll provide day-to-day leadership across the Engineering team — ensuring we have the right resources in place to respond to breakdowns, complete planned work and keep our equipment running reliably.

You’ll be someone who enjoys being close to the operation, building strong relationships with Production and making sure engineering is visible, responsive and focused on delivering results.

In this role, you will:

• Coordinate the day-to-day Engineering workload, ensuring priorities are clearly communicated and followed through

• Allocate engineering resource effectively to support breakdowns, planned maintenance and operational requirements

• Work closely with Production to understand priorities, provide effective engineering support and improve collaboration between the two teams

• Drive the completion and continual review of Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM), identifying opportunities to improve equipment reliability and maintenance effectiveness

• Review recurring breakdowns and equipment failures, working with the team to identify practical opportunities for improvement

• Support and develop the Shift Engineering and Asset Care teams, providing guidance, coaching and day-to-day leadership

• Coordinate OEMs, contractors and suppliers where required, ensuring work is planned, managed and completed effectively

• Support engineering audits, documentation, compliance and maintenance standards across the site

• Help ensure engineering systems, processes and priorities are consistently followed

• Provide cover and support for Engineering Stores and Administration when required

• Escalate higher-value expenditure, significant technical issues and wider engineering risks to the Reliability Manager

• Provide cover for the Reliability Manager when required, helping maintain the effective day-to-day running of the Engineering function

• Be flexible to provide engineering leadership and support outside normal working hours when required

You’ll be joining a workplace where collaboration and curiosity are encouraged. Where questioning “how it’s always been done” is part of daily life. And where discovering better ways of working is simply what we do.

ABOUT YOU

We want to work with people who are bold, ambitious and ready to shape the future — people who share our values and bring energy, ideas and commitment.

You’ll bring:

• Proven experience in an engineering, maintenance or reliability role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment

title: National Senior Director, Partner Relations
description:
The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is seeking an experienced, strategic, and mission-driven development professional to serve as National Senior Director, Partner Relations. This senior leadership role is responsible for portfolio-level revenue oversight, operational excellence, and scalable growth across ADA’s multi-million-dollar corporate partnership portfolio, with a focus on science-, pharmaceutical-, medical device-, diagnostics-, and diabetes technology-based collaborations across diabetes, prediabetes, obesity, and cardiometabolic health impact areas in the U.S. and globally. The role requires the ability to understand and translate scientific advances including emerging developments in type 1 diabetes (T1D), diabetes technology, therapeutic innovation, and related areas of diabetes science into compelling, funder-facing opportunities for corporate partners.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership across senior revenue-owning roles, including National Director(s) and Director-level Partner Relations staff, ensuring consistency, performance, and sustainability as the portfolio continues to scale beyond $50M+ annually. Working in close partnership with the Senior Vice President of Partner Relations, the Senior Director serves as the architect and steward of the Partner Relations operating model with significant focus on growing revenue, driving disciplined portfolio management, strengthening internal systems and processes, and enabling high-performing account leadership across pharmaceutical, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare partners.

While the National Senior Director owns and executes individual high-value partner relationships, they ensure the portfolio functions as an integrated, high-performing engine, balancing growth, risk, renewal strength, and internal readiness to support ADA’s national and global priorities across diabetes, obesity, and cardiometabolic health.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Leadership & Revenue Governance

  • Provide senior oversight across multiple Partner Relations high level portfolios, including those led by National Director(s), ensuring alignment with organizational strategy, revenue targets, and partner priorities.
  • Cultivate and expand long-term, high-value relationships with leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device partners, generating new and expanded seven-figure opportunities.
  • Lead independently and alongside Vice President of Partner Relations to develop and negotiate new multi-year, seven-figure agreements aligned with ADA’s mission, programs, and business priorities.
  • Maintain accountability for portfolio-level revenue performance across various type of agreements ($50M+ annually), including forecasting, diversification, renewal strength, and risk mitigation.
  • Review, guide, and challenge account strategies, deal structures, renewal pathways, and multi-year growth plans for high-value partnerships prior to executive approval.
  • Ensure consistency in partner value propositions, pricing logic, engagement models, and stewardship standards across portfolios.

Revenue Growth Enablement

  • Work closely with Subject Matter Experts and Portfolio Leaders across various internal Departments to develop new concepts and develop strategic approaches for new asks.
  • Write, shape, and develop scientifically grounded proposals and partnership concepts for corporate partners, translating scientific priorities, emerging evidence, and ADA programmatic strengths into compelling funder-facing opportunities.
  • Enable and support senior leaders in identifying, structuring, and closing complex, multi-year, seven-figure partnerships.
  • Partner with the Vice President of Partner Relations on strategic negotiations, escalations, and enterprise-level partner relationships as needed.
  • Drive disciplined portfolio planning to balance near-term revenue delivery with long-term partnership sustainability and growth.
  • Support expansion into new funding models, therapeutic areas, and partnership structures aligned with ADA’s strategic pillars.

Operating Model & Process Ownership

  • Own and continuously improve the Partner Relations operating model, including proposal intake, prioritization, internal review, approval pathways, contracting readiness, and execution handoffs.
  • Develop and implement scalable systems, tools, templates, and playbooks to improve proposal quality, speed-to-contract, and internal coordination.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and execution risks; proactively design and implement solutions.
  • Ensure readiness for growth as proposal volume, partner complexity, and revenue targets increase.

Leadership, Management & Talent Development

  • Provide direct oversight, coaching, and strategic guidance to National Director-level Partner Relations staff.
  • Serve as a primary escalation point for complex portfolio decisions, cross-functional dependencies, and resourcing challenges.
  • Mentor senior team members on strategic account planning, executive engagement, negotiation readiness, and portfolio thinking.
  • Oversee content development and presentation when communicating with partners to ensure content and reporting remains aligned to partnership goals and vision.
  • Partner with the Vice President of Partner Relations to assess staffing models, role design, and future capacity needs to support growth.

Cross-Functional Integration & Execution Excellence

  • Ensure strong coordination across Science & Health Care, Advocacy, Quality and Access, Marketing, Legal/Finance, PMO, and Operations to deliver high-quality, funder-aligned programs.
  • Champion internal clarity on roles, responsibilities, timelines, and decision rights across the partnership lifecycle.
  • Support consistent, high-quality stewardship, reporting, and partner engagement across portfolios.
  • Represent ADA with credibility and professionalism in senior-level internal and external settings as appropriate.

Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning

  • Maintain a portfolio-level view of the pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and healthcare landscape, including market trends, therapeutic pipelines, and competitive dynamics.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of scientific developments and advances in diabetes science, including emerging research, therapeutic innovation, diabetes technology, and areas of rapid progress in type 1 diabetes.
  • Translate market intelligence into portfolio strategy, growth priorities, and partnership innovation opportunities.
  • Support ADA’s positioning as a premier convener, thought leader, and partner of choice for industry leaders committed to diabetes, obesity, and health equity.


Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MPH, MHA, MS, PhD) experience strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in corporate partnerships, strategic account management, business development, or revenue leadership within healthcare, life sciences, or healthcare nonprofit sectors.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and develop scientific proposals, concept papers, or funder-facing materials for corporate partners in healthcare, life sciences, diabetes, obesity, or related therapeutic areas.
  • Demonstrated success overseeing large, complex partnership portfolios with aggregate revenue of $50M+ annually with strategic with seven-figure proposals development.
  • Proven ability to design and scale operating models, processes, and systems that support revenue growth.
  • Strong strategic, financial, and operational acumen with experience guiding senior revenue leaders.
  • Strong Excel skills, including the ability to manage budgets, forecasts, pipeline tracking, dashboards, and revenue reporting with accuracy and attention to detail.

Strongly Preferred

  • Deep familiarity with diabetes, obesity, cardiometabolic care, or adjacent therapeutic areas.
  • Knowledge of diabetes technology, digital health, continuous glucose monitoring, insulin delivery systems, or related innovations; direct experience in this area is preferred.
  • Knowledge of advances in diabetes science, particularly in the type 1 diabetes space, is preferred.
  • Experience working with pharmaceutical, medical device, diagnostics, or digital health partners.
  • Experience and understanding of compliance and legal requirements in the industry.
  • Track record of managing and mentoring senior-level partnership or business development leaders.
  • Experience with multi-year agreements, complex negotiations, and enterprise-level partnerships.
  • Exposure to clinical research, quality improvement, population health, or health access initiatives.

Other Requirements

  • Commitment to ADA’s mission to improve the lives of people with diabetes and obesity and to advance innovation and equity in care.
  • Ability to travel as needed (estimated 20%) to cultivate partner relationships and lead revenue goals.

Why Work Here
The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) offers a rewarding career working for one of the premier voluntary health organizations in the world supporting people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Our employees consistently say that our mission, culture, work-life balance, and total rewards package are what they like most about working at the ADA. benefits and our culture:

  • Industry competitive base pay. Base offers are determined by several factors including but not limited to your relevant work experience, education, certifications, location, internal pay equity, etc.
  • A culture of recognition including new hire welcome announcements, service anniversary awards, referral bonuses, monthly All Employee Assembly, appreciation awards
  • Generous Paid Time Off, including holidays, vacation days, personal days and sick days
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), disability & life insurance, pet insurance, and retirement savings
  • Guided by our mission, we provide full diabetes supply coverage through our medical benefits program
  • A company focus on offering mental health programs and work/life balance with most of our employees working remote
  • Joining our dedicated team affords the gratification of knowing beyond a doubt that you will impact the lives and well-being of millions


About the Organization
The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) is the nation’s leading voluntary health organization fighting to end diabetes and helping people living with diabetes thrive. Since 1940, we have driven discovery and research to prevent, manage, treat, and ultimately cure diabetes. We advocate for policy changes and improved access to quality care for all people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Through the Obesity Association, a division of the ADA, we are also working to reduce the prevalence of obesity—a leading risk factor for type 2 diabetes.

title: Area Scout - Panama
description:
DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW / DESCRIPCIÓN DEL DEPARTAMENTO

The Boston Red Sox International Scouting Department is committed to identifying and acquiring impact amateur and professional talent globally and integrating them into our player development system. We empower our staff to grow as individuals while we strive as a team to be at the forefront of the industry’s best practices in relation to player evaluation, analytical methods and staff development.

El Departamento de Escouteo Internacional de los Boston Red Sox está comprometido con identificar y adquirir talento amateur y profesional de impacto a nivel mundial, integrándolo a nuestro sistema de desarrollo de jugadores. Brindamos a nuestro personal las herramientas para crecer como individuos, mientras trabajamos en equipo para mantenernos a la vanguardia de las mejores prácticas de la industria en cuanto a evaluación de jugadores, métodos de análisis y desarrollo del personal.

POSITION OVERVIEW / DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PUESTO:

The Boston Red Sox are seeking an Area Scout to cover territory in Panama. In this role, the Area Scout will cover and report on players in Panama, collaborate with other scouting staff and leadership, and make recommendations on signing players. The Area Scout will also help with additional assignments/coverages as assigned by immediate supervisors.

Candidates must reside in Panama year-round to be considered.

Los Boston Red Sox están buscando un Scout de Área para cubrir territorio en Panama. En este rol, el Scout de Área será responsable de dar cobertura y reportar sobre jugadores en Panama, colaborar con otros miembros del personal de escouteo y con el liderazgo, y hacer recomendaciones sobre la firma de jugadores. Además, apoyará en tareas adicionales o coberturas según lo asignen sus supervisores inmediatos.

Los candidatos deben residir en Panama de manera permanente para ser considerados.

RESPONSIBILITIES/RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Primary Scout for assigned area, including evaluating talent, reporting responsibilities and establishing a thorough network (players, trainers/coaches, player representatives).
  • Maintain a detailed preference list for players in your assigned area and any other players you report on.
  • Develop a working knowledge of specified technologies as well as how to apply your results to the evaluation process.
  • Collect data, physical assessments, and video of players .
  • Evaluate player makeup and build relationships with players and their families.
  • Provide regular updates to superiors on players in your territory.
  • Coordinate tryouts and cover assigned events inside and outside your territory.
  • Submit expenses in a timely manner per the policies set forth by the Boston Red Sox.
  • Be cognizant of International Scouting policies as dictated by MLB, make sure you are compliant with rules set forth by MLB and the Boston Red Sox.
  • Participate in any professional development exercises as assigned by supervisors.
  • Ser el Scout principal del área asignada, incluyendo la evaluación de talento, la elaboración de reportes y el establecimiento de una red completa de contactos (jugadores, entrenadores, representantes de jugadores)
  • Mantener una lista detallada de preferencias para los jugadores de tu área asignada y cualquier otro jugador sobre el cual realices reportes.
  • Desarrollar un conocimiento práctico de las tecnologías especificadas, así como de la aplicación de sus resultados al proceso de evaluación.
  • Recopilar datos, evaluaciones físicas y videos de jugadores.
  • Evaluar el carácter y la disposición del jugador, además de construir relaciones con los jugadores y sus familias.
  • Proporcionar actualizaciones periódicas a los supervisores sobre los jugadores en tu territorio.
  • Coordinar tryouts y cubrir eventos asignados dentro y fuera de tu territorio.
  • Presentar los gastos de manera oportuna, de acuerdo con las políticas establecidas por los Boston Red Sox.
  • Conocer las políticas de Escouteo Internacional dictadas por MLB y asegurarse de cumplir con las reglas establecidas tanto por MLB como por los Boston Red Sox.
  • Participar en los programas de desarrollo profesional que indiquen los supervisores.

COMPETENCIES/COMPETENCIAS:

  • Strong ability to build relationships, communicate effectively, and connect with players, coaches, agents, and trainers from varying backgrounds.
  • High level of work ethic, honesty, and desire to learn
  • Familiarity with necessary hardware, tools, technology and equipment to conduct player evaluations.
  • An understanding of the landscape, market and context of the Dominican Republic and International scouting.
  • Able to collect and utilize the information necessary to complete a full scouting process.

    • Gran habilidad para construir relaciones, comunicarse de manera efectiva y conectar con jugadores, entrenadores, y agentes de distintos orígenes.
    • Alto nivel de ética de trabajo, honestidad y deseo de aprender.
    • Familiaridad con el equipo, las herramientas, la tecnología y el material necesarios para realizar evaluaciones de jugadores.
    • Conocimiento del panorama, el mercado y el contexto de la República Dominicana y del escouteo internacional.
    • Capacidad para recopilar y utilizar la información necesaria para completar un proceso de escouteo completo.

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS/CUALIFICACIONES ADICIONALES

  • Must have a Driver’s License valid in the assigned area.
  • Must have regular access to a car in the assigned area.
    • Debe tener una licencia de conducir válida en el área asignada.
    • Debe contar con acceso regular a un vehículo en el área asignada.

      • In addition to the above requirements, all roles within Baseball Operations are expected to effectively demonstrate our universal competencies related to problem solving, teamwork, clarity of communication, and time management, along with embodying our culture of honesty, humility, relentlessness, and commitment to DEIB.

title: Senior Data Engineer

title: Senior Java Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Wholesale Lending Technology

At ING, we're empowering people to stay a step ahead in life and business. Through innovation, technology, and collaboration, we're transforming banking and creating solutions that make a real impact globally.

title: Full Time Branch Ambassador - Baton Rouge Area
description:
Full Time Branch Ambassador - Baton Rouge Area

Welcome to the future of banking. At Capital One, we believe your bank should be as mobile, intuitive, and human as the rest of your life. We are reimagining the way people interact with their money by creating community hubs where technology meets human empathy.

As a Branch Ambassador, you are the heartbeat of our space. You don't just "process transactions"—you embody our culture of outstanding hospitality. You are a relationship-builder who blends friendly, attentive service with cutting-edge digital innovation. Whether you’re helping a client navigate our latest tools or empowering them to reach their financial goals, you are the face of an exceptional, human-centric experience.

We are looking for curious, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-moving environment. You are someone who doesn't wait to be asked; you anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and have a genuine passion for helping people thrive in an evolving digital world.

What You’ll Actually Do

The Guardian of Trust & Accuracy You are the bedrock of our environment’s safety and integrity. You’ll execute high-volume cash transactions—including deposits, withdrawals, and complex negotiable instrument processing—with 100% accuracy. You maintain a "compliance-first" mindset, ensuring all security, audit, BSA/AML, and federal regulatory standards are met with precision to keep our customers' assets safe.

The Digital Concierge You are a mentor in a digital world. You’ll educate clients on how to leverage mobile banking, remote deposit capture, and contactless payments, helping them gain convenience and security in their daily financial lives.

The First-Line Consultant You aren’t just answering questions; you’re identifying needs. By actively listening, you’ll uncover personal or business goals and pair them with the right digital tools or banking solutions to help them succeed.

The Hospitality Lead You move fluidly throughout the space, greeting customers and ensuring no one ever feels like just a "number." You balance the efficiency of a high-volume operation with the warmth of a community-focused partner.

What You Bring

  • A Hospitality Heart: You have a natural gift for making people feel welcome and heard.
  • Tech Fluency: You are an early adopter of apps and digital tools and love teaching others how to use them.
  • Precision and Detail: You find satisfaction in getting the numbers right every single time and following clear procedures.
  • Adaptability: You enjoy a "fluid" workspace where you might move from a cash drawer to a digital demo in minutes.
  • Curiosity: You want to know the "why" behind the "how" and are always looking for ways to improve the customer journey.

Why Join Us?

This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.

The Perks

We provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to fuel your journey. Whether you’re using our education assistance to prepare for your next career move, or taking advantage of our mental and physical health resources to stay at your best, we invest in you as a whole person. Our goal is to ensure that wherever your career takes you—within Capital One or into the wider world—you leave the Branch stronger than when you started.

  • Day 1 coverage for Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescriptions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Education Assistance
  • Matching 401(k) contribution up to 7.5%
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Mental Health support
  • Back-up Child or Elder Care
  • And much more!

Essential Functions (Included, but not limited to)

  • Support surrounding Branches as needed within a 50 mile radius, with occasional opportunities to assist other locations in the broader Region.
  • Available to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, with hours and days subject to change.
  • While the company provides reasonable notice for permanent schedule changes in accordance with state and local laws, the ability to adapt to business-driven schedule adjustments is required.
  • Applicants must be able to attend all required training sessions, which may occur on a schedule differing from the primary shift.
  • Lifting up to 25 pounds and moving/standing for extended periods of time
  • Regular and consistent attendance

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent Certification
  • At least 1 year of Retail, Sales, or Customer Service experience
  • At least 6 months of cash handling experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree
  • 2+ years of Retail or Customer-facing experience
  • Proficient in G-Suite
  • Strong written and oral communication skills

After you apply

You may be required to take an assessment. It takes about 35 minutes to complete. If you’re selected to move forward, one of our recruiters will reach out to tell you more about the role and answer your questions.

Does this sound like the career move you’ve been looking for? Let’s build the future of banking together!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description:

As a Software Engineer at Arm, you will join the Chip Methodology & Automation (CMA) team in the Solutions Engineering organization. This team creates scalable methodologies, workflows, and automation. These help engineering teams deploy Arm-based SoCs efficiently and consistently. Your role includes developing scalable Linux-based tools and shared infrastructure. You will focus on Python development, reusable automation, tool integration, performance, and reliability to improve engineering workflow efficiency.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop maintainable Linux tools and command-line applications, preferably using Python.
  • Contribute to modular architectures supporting multiple tools, projects, and engineering teams.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and implement automation that improves execution time, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Build reusable infrastructure, APIs, interfaces, and integration patterns for engineering applications.
  • Implement process execution, environment management, error handling, logging, and diagnostics.
  • Build structured configuration and compatibility contracts using YAML, JSON, or schemas.
  • Develop unit, integration, regression, performance, and system tests.
  • Profile and optimize CPU, memory, filesystem, network, and batch-processing workloads.
  • Support packaging, deployment, versioning, backward compatibility, and release automation.
  • Participate in requirements analysis, technical development, code reviews, and validation planning.
  • Build user documentation, provide integration mentorship, and develop material for fixing issues.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Software development experience in Python or a comparable language, with a strong preference for Python.
  • Good understanding of Linux operating systems, command-line environments, processes, and filesystems.
  • Experience crafting modular and reusable software components.
  • Experience with Git, automated testing, debugging, and code reviews.
  • Familiarity with shell scripting, process automation, YAML, and JSON.
  • Understanding of software performance, reliability, error handling, and logging.
  • Ability to independently deliver well-defined features with limited supervision.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Experience with pytest, Python packaging, or extensible CLI frameworks.
  • Familiarity with scalable platform architecture, plugins, APIs, or service-based integrations.
  • Experience building secure and auditable execution frameworks.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing, job schedulers, containers, or shared Linux environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated release workflows.
  • Knowledge of concurrency, caching, profiling, or large-scale filesystem operations.
  • Exposure to semiconductor, EDA, or engineering automation workflows.

description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Regional Director, Cyber Security Business Growth (Northern Europe)

Overview

Services are a key differentiator for Mastercard, delivering cutting-edge solutions that help our customers grow. Built on data-driven technologies and innovation, our offerings span consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation, and information and risk management. Today, Mastercard has evolved into a comprehensive technology and services platform, expanding into security, loyalty, personalisation, and advanced data analytics to help banks, merchants, and governments deliver smarter, more secure, and highly personalised customer experiences.

Security in particular is a core part of this mission, and Mastercard has grown into a leading global cybersecurity vendor. With the rise of digital commerce, security challenges have become more complex. Cyber threats now extend beyond individual transactions to entire digital ecosystems, requiring a broader approach to protection. Recognising this, Mastercard strengthened its cybersecurity offerings through strategic acquisitions, beginning with Risk Recon in 2019 and more recently Recorded Future, a global leader in threat intelligence. These additions enable Mastercard to offer solutions such as advanced cyber risk assessment and real-time threat intelligence, helping clients safeguard their entire digital footprint—not just the payments themselves.

About the Role

The Regional Director, Cyber Security Business Growth will lead the growth of Mastercard’s Cyber business in the Northern Europe region. As the P&L owner, you will drive strategic growth, commercial success, and profitability — building a high-performing sales organisation while engaging directly with clients to expand our cybersecurity footprint.


Responsibilities

Build & Oversee the GTM Operating Model

• Define a collaborative operating model with clear joint account coverage.
• Align sales and business development teams under a unified Mastercard Cyber narrative and sales process.

Coordinate Internal Execution Across Teams

• Facilitate client introductions across business lines, driving cross-sell opportunities between Recorded Future, RiskRecon, and Consulting.
• Oversee sales enablement, including collateral, pitch decks, training, and pipeline visibility.
• Align product, sales, customer success, and marketing teams around launches and revenue goals.

Lead Specialist Cyber Sales

• Own end-to-end sales execution, with emphasis on consulting bundles.
• Drive Recorded Future and RiskRecon referrals for Mastercard-managed accounts.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Track and report on commercial integration progress, lead funnel health, and conversion efficiency.
• Identify integration risks, take corrective actions, and communicate progress clearly to stakeholders.


Required Qualifications

Commercial & Consulting Expertise

• Extensive client-facing experience, from needs assessment through solution design and delivery of high-impact consulting and technology engagements.
• Strong business development track record — identifying opportunities, crafting proposals, scoping solutions, and driving them to closure.
• Skilled at building trust-based, long-term relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from mid-management to the C-suite.

Cybersecurity Expertise

• Proven ability to translate complex cybersecurity and consulting concepts into clear, compelling client narratives.
• Industry savvy, understanding emerging cyber trends and creatively leveraging market opportunities.
• Working experience with sales of security services, consulting and/or technologies such as cyber threat intelligence, security awareness and training, cloud security, crisis and incident response management, third party risk management, threat and vulnerability management, security in disruptive technologies such as CRQ – Cyber Risk Quantification, web application firewall, and identity theft protection.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and aligning diverse stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
• Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment without formal authority.
• Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
• Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic environments with shifting priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with the application of information security standards and good practices (such as PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO27001, NIST, CIS, CSA).
• Experience with payment ecosystem security: understanding of security needs of traditional financial services customers e.g. Acquirers, Processors, Issuers and customers from other related segments e.g. merchants, SMB, and government.
• Experience in managing P&L responsibility or similar business ownership roles, with a focus on growth and profitability.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Head of Delivery Management
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for en forretningskritisk leverancefunktion, skabe energi og følgeskab og sikre sammenhæng mellem projekter, services og kunderelationer? Så er du måske vores nye Head of Delivery Management.

Conscia er i vækst og løbende transformation. Derfor søger vi en synlig og handlekraftig leder, der kan samle Project Management og Service Delivery Management om en fælles retning, styrke den kommercielle forståelse i leverancerne og omsætte strategi, data og kundebehov til tydelige prioriteringer og handling.

Din rolle
Som Head of Delivery Management bliver du en del af ledelsen i Delivery Excellence og får ansvaret for at udvikle og drive en skalerbar og samlet Delivery Management-funktion på tværs af Project Management og Service Delivery Management.

Stillingen er nyoprettet og giver dig en unik mulighed for at sætte dit præg på rollen, samarbejdsmodellen, områdets fremtidige udvikling og – ikke mindst – kundeoplevelsen. Du får samtidig ansvar for den daglige ledelse af Project Management med ansvar for personaleledelse, performance, prioritering, faglig sparring og udvikling af projektlederne.

For SDM-området arbejder du tæt sammen med den ansvarlige for vores Service Delivery Management, som har det daglige ledelses- og personaleansvar. Sammen sikrer I fælles retning, klare snitflader og en sammenhængende kundeoplevelse fra projekt til stabil drift.

Dine vigtigste opgaver
  • Sætte retningen for Delivery Management og omsætte strategi og kundebehov til klare prioriteringer, mål og handlinger.
  • Lede og udvikle Project Management-teamet gennem tydelige forventninger, nærværende ledelse og målrettet kompetenceudvikling.
  • Sikre et samlet porteføljeoverblik og prioritere ressourcer på tværs af projektleverancer med fokus på fremdrift, økonomi, kvalitet, risici og kundetilfredshed.
  • Drive en enkel og effektiv leverancegovernance med tydelige KPI’er, konsekvent opfølgning og løbende forbedring af processer og leverancemodeller.
  • Tage ledelsesmæssigt ejerskab for kritiske leverancer og tværgående eskalationer samt sikre rettidig handling og fremdrift på tværs af PM, SDM, Sales og de tekniske leveranceorganisationer.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har solid og dokumenteret ledelseserfaring fra en kompleks projekt-, service- eller leveranceorganisation.
  • Har erfaring med daglig ledelse af projektledere og med styring af en portefølje med mange samtidige leverancer.
  • Har stærk forståelse for både Project Management og Service Delivery Management og for samspillet mellem kommercielle, operationelle og tekniske funktioner.
  • Har solid erfaring med projektgovernance, økonomistyring, risikostyring, leveranceopfølgning og eskalationshåndtering.
  • Er forretningsorienteret og kan omsætte operationelle data, kundebehov og markedsmuligheder til beslutninger, der styrker både kundeværdi og forretning.
  • Kommunikerer klart og troværdigt på dansk og engelsk og kan skabe følgeskab på tværs af fagligheder og organisatoriske niveauer.

Som person er du
  • Inspirerende og motiverende i din ledelsesstil, og skaber energi, engagement og lyst til at lykkes sammen.
  • Synlig, nærværende og handlekraftig samt i stand til at sætte retning og følge konsekvent op.
  • Kommercielt nysgerrig og optaget af, hvordan stærke leverancer kan drive vækst, loyalitet og langsigtede kunderelationer.
  • Struktureret og analytisk, men samtidig pragmatisk nok til at træffe beslutninger og få ting til at ske.
  • Robust i komplekse situationer og i stand til at bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt.
  • Forandringsparat og motiveret af at arbejde i en organisation i løbende transformation og vækst.
  • Modig nok til at udfordre status quo og tydelig nok til at adressere afvigelser, før de vokser sig store.

Conscia tilbyder
Hos Conscia bliver du en del af en ambitiøs og voksende virksomhed med høj faglighed, korte beslutningsveje og en uformel omgangstone. Du får reel mulighed for at præge, hvordan vi leder og skalerer vores leverancer, og du bliver en del af et lederfællesskab, hvor vi udfordrer hinanden og vinder sammen.

Vi tilbyder frihed under ansvar, fleksibilitet i hverdagen og mulighed for at arbejde fra vores kontor i Nordhavn eller Aarhus. Hertil kommer en attraktiv lønpakke, pensions- og sundhedsordning, uddannelsesmuligheder, frokostordning, moderne kontorfaciliteter og sociale arrangementer på tværs af virksomheden.

Næste skridt
Vi læser alle ansøgninger, indkalder til samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Tiltrædelse er snarest muligt. Vi forbeholder os retten til at fjerne jobannoncen, når stillingen er besat.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Morten Eriksen, Director Delivery Excellence moe@conscia.com.

title: Management Assistant - Tech
description:
Purpose of the role

The Management Assistant supports the IT Leadership (ITL) and IT Area Leadership (ITAL) teams in organizing their daily operations efficiently. The role ensures professional, smooth, and well-coordinated support in calendar and meeting management, events, administrative processes, communication, and travel organization. By proactively anticipating needs and priorities, the Management Assistant helps leaders focus as much as possible on their strategic and operational responsibilities.

Key responsibilities

1. Calendar management

Responsible for proactive and efficient management of the calendars of ITL and ITAL.

  • Manage and optimize complex calendars of ITL and ITAL members.
  • Efficiently schedule, reschedule, and coordinate meetings, where needed in consultation with other management assistants.
  • Ensure calendars are always up to date and avoid double bookings.
  • Identify and discuss planning risks, priority conflicts, and capacity issues in a timely manner.
  • Organize and schedule Sharing Sessions, Technology Trends sessions, Ask Me Anything sessions, Listening Sessions, Monthly Drinks, leadership meetings, and strategic workshops.

2. General support

Support ITL and ITAL in daily operational and administrative activities.

  • Book meeting rooms and workspaces.
  • Organize catering, lunches, and dinners.
  • Reserve restaurants for internal and external meetings.
  • Submit and follow up on expense claims and expense reports.
  • Process administrative requests and ad hoc requests.
  • Register and guide visitors.
  • Reserve parking spaces for visitors and employees.
  • Place and follow up on orders via SpotBuy.
  • Manage and update distribution lists, mailboxes, and relevant administrative data.

3. Communication and stakeholder support

Support internal communication and collaboration within Tech BE.

  • Work closely and align with Business Managers and the Communication Team.
  • Support the preparation of Management Team meetings.
  • Help prepare and distribute MT agendas, for example for MT C&D.
  • Maintain and update management information.
  • Update organizational and reporting structures monthly for publication on the intranet, including organograms for DP and C&D.
  • Act as a point of contact for practical and organizational questions from ITL, ITAL, and their teams.

4. Travel management

Coordinate professional and cost-efficient business travel for ITL and ITAL.

  • Organize and book international and domestic travel.
  • Reserve transport, accommodation, and required facilities.
  • Support travel documentation and administrative follow-up.
  • Monitor compliance with internal travel guidelines and budgets.

5. Events and engagement

Organize activities that support collaboration, communication, and engagement.

  • Organize Townhalls for IT Leadership.
  • Coordinate offsites, workshops, and leadership events.
  • Support internal networking and engagement activities.
  • Coordinate practical organization, logistics, communication, and follow-up.
  • Align with suppliers, facility services, and internal stakeholders.

Behavioral competencies

Organizational ability: Strong in planning, prioritizing, and follow-up. Able to manage multiple topics simultaneously and maintain oversight in a dynamic environment.

Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and audience-oriented, both in writing and verbally. Comfortable interacting with senior management.

Collaboration: Builds strong working relationships with management assistants, business managers, communication colleagues, and other stakeholders.

Proactivity: Anticipates needs, bottlenecks, and risks. Flags issues in a timely manner and proposes practical solutions.

Discretion and reliability: Handles sensitive information carefully and confidentially. Works accurately, with integrity, and consistently.

Results orientation: Ensures timely delivery and high-quality support. Takes ownership of assigned tasks and follows actions through to closure.

Resilience: Continues to operate effectively when priorities change, calendars are busy, and ad hoc requests arise.

Technical competencies

  • Fully proficient in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong in planning, organization, and follow-up of activities.
  • Able to correctly apply internal policies and procedures.
  • Comfortable with administrative systems for expense management, travel, orders, and facility support.
  • Able to prepare, structure, and follow up on complex documents or practical overviews.

Profile

  • At least 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in management, personal, or executive support.
  • Experience with calendar, meeting, travel, and event management.
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
  • Professional, flexible, and customer-oriented mindset.
  • Able to work independently, while knowing when alignment or escalation is needed.

Contribution to the organization

This role directly supports the IT Leadership community and contributes to the efficient functioning of the Tech organization through administrative excellence, operational support, and a professional stakeholder experience. The Management Assistant helps make priorities visible, facilitate collaboration, and give leaders time and focus for strategic and operational decision-making.

title: Senior iOS (Swift) Engineer
description:
Our Story
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at !
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

About the team

We are a mobile-first bank, and our iOS app is a critical part of how customers experience Zopa.

Having recently completed our migration to fully native mobile, we are now focused on making our iOS platform exceptional: fast, reliable, accessible and easy for engineers to build on.

You’ll join our Mobile Platform team, which owns the shared capabilities that underpin the app, including architecture, shared modules, design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD.

The team’s role is not to own all technical decisions. It is to help shape the direction of mobile engineering at Zopa, create great developer experiences for our product teams, and make it easier for engineers to focus on customer problems rather than underlying technical complexity.

You’ll also be part of a strong iOS engineering community, contributing to standards, sharing knowledge and helping us continue to mature our native engineering practice.

A Day in the life:

  • Partner closely with the Engineering Manager, Principal Mobile Engineer and Head of Mobile Engineering to deliver Zopa’s mobile strategy.
  • Help shape the technical direction and standards for iOS across Zopa.
  • Design and evolve shared modules, APIs, architecture and developer tooling that enable multiple teams to build and ship with confidence.
  • Identify technical risks early, using data, profiling and observability to improve performance, reliability and developer experience.
  • Stay highly hands-on, delivering production-quality Swift and SwiftUI code across platform and customer-facing product work.
  • Raise the capability of other engineers through pairing, code reviews, technical discussions and knowledge sharing.
  • Work closely with Product, Design, Backend and Android colleagues to make well-rounded decisions, influence direction and respect each discipline’s expertise.

About you:

  • Strong experience building and maintaining customer-facing iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Deep knowledge of iOS development, including concurrency, performance, memory management, testing, accessibility and security.
  • Sound architectural and API-design judgement, with a focus on simple, maintainable solutions and an excellent developer experience.
  • A proactive engineer who identifies problems, shapes practical solutions and influences improvements beyond their immediate team.
  • A collaborative teammate who raises the capability of others through coaching, pairing and knowledge sharing.
  • Comfortable constructively challenging ideas, while remaining open-minded and willing to change course when better evidence emerges.
  • Genuine curiosity about mobile engineering and the evolving iOS platform.

Added bonus:

  • Background in fintech, banking or another regulated, high-trust environment where reliability and customer confidence matter.
  • A track record of building shared libraries, platform capabilities or design systems that help engineering teams move faster.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of UIKit and its place within modern iOS development.
  • Proven impact improving mobile CI/CD pipelines, release processes and developer tooling.
  • Confidence using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and code quality.
#LI-IB1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Senior Partner Enablement Program Manager
description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most.
